mafaranga yacyo, igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gifite izo mva ku butaka bwacyo gishobora gusaba ko
cyemererwa gufasha mu gusubiza ibisigazwa
by’imibiri y’abapfuye mu gihugu
bakomokagamo.Iyo ubwo busabe bwanzwe, igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano, nyuma y’imyaka itanu
bukozwe, kimaze kandi kubimenyesha igihugu abo
bapfuye bakomokagamo, gishobora gukurikiza
ibiteganywa mu mategeko yacyo yerekeye amarimbi
n’imva.
4. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano, gifite imva
zivugwa muri iyi ngingo ku butaka bwacyo
cyemerewe gutaburura imibiri gusa:
a) mu buryo buvugwa mu gika cya 2 agace ka c) no
mu gika cya 3; cyangwa
b) mu gihe itabururwa ribaye ngombwa kubera
impamvu zishingiye ku nyungu rusange, harimo
n’igihe bibaye ngombwa mu rwego rwo
kubungabunga ubuzima cyangwa gukora
amaperereza, muri ibyo bihe igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano kikaba kigomba, igihe cyose, kubaba
ibyo bisigazwa by’iyo mibiri, kandi kikabanza
kumenyesha igihugu abo bapfuye bakomokagamo ko
giteganya gutaburura ibisigazwa by’imibiri yabo
n’aho giteganya kongera kubishyingura.
IGICE CYA III: UBURYO N’IBIKORESHO
BY’INTAMBARA N’UKO IMFUNGWA
Z’INTAMBARA ZIFATWA
ICYICIIRO CYA I: UBURYO N’IBIKORESHO
BY’INTAMBARA

articles.heading: Amategeko y’ibanze 1. Mu ntambara iyo ari yo yose uburenganzira bw’ ibihugu biri mu ntambara bwo guhitamo uburyo
articles.text:
n’ibikoresho by’intambara bugira aho bugarukira.
2. Birabujijwe gukoresha intwaro, ibisasu biraswa
kure, n’ibikoresho kimwe n’uburyo bw’intambara
biteye ku buryo biteza ibikomere birengeje urugero
cyangwa ububabare butari ngombwa.
3. Birabujijwe gukoresha uburyo cyangwa ibikoresho
by’intambara bigenewe, cyangwa bibonwa ko
byateza iyangirika ry’ibidukikije karemano rirambye
kandi rikabije ahantu hanini.

articles.heading: Intwaro nshya Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano, mu gihe gitegura, gishyiraho, gishaka cyangwa cyemeza intwaro nshya
articles.text:
cyangwa uburyo bw’intambara bushya, gifite
inshingano yo kugaragaza neza niba, mu bihe bimwe
na bimwe cyangwa mu bihe byose, ikoreshwa ryabyo
rishobora kubuzwa n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
cyangwa andi mategeko mpuzamahanga ayo ari yo
yose icyo gihugu cyemeye gukurikiza.

articles.heading: Ibuzwa ry’ ubushukanyi mu ntambara 1. Birabujijwe kwica, gukomeretsa cyangwa gufata uwo muhanganye hakoreshejwe ubushukanyi
articles.text:
Ubushukanyi ni ibikorwa bigamije kubeshya uwo
muhanganye ku bushake, bituma yumva ko
yemerewe cyangwa ko afite inshingano yo gutanga
uburengerwe buteganywa n’amahame y’amategeko
mpuzamahanga akurikizwa mu ntambara.Ibikorwa
bikurikira ni zimwe mu ngero z’ubushukanyi:
a) kwigira nk’ushaka imishyikirano binyuze mu
kuzamura ibendera ry’amahoro cyangwa kwigira
nk’uyamanitse;
b)kwigira nk’utagishoboye kurwana kubera
ibikomere cyangwa uburwayi;
c)kwigira cyangwa kubeshya ko ari umusivili
cyangwa ko atari umurwanyi;
d) kwigira nk’uwemerewe kurengerwa binyuze mu
gukoresha ibimenyetso, ibirango cyangwa
impuzankano z’Umuryango w’Abibumbye,
z’Igihugu kidafite aho kibogamiye cyangwa z’ikindi
gihugu kidafite uruhare mu ntambara.
2. Amayeri y’intambara ntabujijwe. Amayeri
y’intambara ni ibikorwa bigamije kuyobya uburari
uwo muhanganye cyangwa gutuma ahubuka, ariko
bitanyuranyije n’amategeko mpuzamahanga
akurikizwa mu ntambara kandi bitarangwamo
ubushukanyi kubera ko bitagamije gutuma umwanzi
agira icyizere ku bijyanye n’ukurengerwa
guteganywa n’ayo mategeko. Ibikorwa bikurikira ni
ingero z’amayeri y’intambara :
ikoreshwa ry’ibintu bifasha kwihisha, imitego
ishukana, ibikorwa byo kuyobya uburari n’amakuru
bitari ukuri.

articles.heading: Ibirango byemewe 1. Birabujijwe gukoresha nabi ikirango kiranga cy’umusaraba w’umutuku, igice cy’ukwezi
articles.text:
cy’umutuku cyangwa intare n’izuba by’umutuku,
cyangwa ibindi birango, ibimenyetso cyangwa
ibyapa biteganywa n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga
cyangwa aya Masezerano y’Inyongera. Birabujijwe
kandi gukoresha nabi mu ntambara ibindi birango,
ibimenyetso cyangwa ibyapa byemewe ku rwego
mpuzamahanga bikoreshwa mu kurengera abantu,
harimo ibendera ry’amahoro, n’ikirango kirengera
umutungo ndangamuco.
2. Birabujijwe gukoresha ikirango kiranga
cy’Umuryango w’Abibumbye, ahatari mu bihe
ikoreshwa ryacyo ryatangiwe uruhushya n’uwo
Muryango.

articles.heading: Ibimenyetso by’ ubwenegihugu 1. Birabujijwe gukoresha, mu ntambara, amabendera, ibitambaro, ibimenyetso, ibirango by’amapeti
articles.text:
cyangwa impuzankano za gisirikare z’igihugu
kidafite aho kibogamiye mu ntambara cyangwa
ikindi gihugu kitayifitemo uruhare.
2. Birabujijwe gukoresha amabendera n’ibitambaro,
ibimenyetso, ibirangamapeti cyangwa impuzankano
za gisirikare z’ibihugu bihanganye mu gihe cyo
kugaba ibitero cyangwa hagamijwe guhisha,
korohereza, kurinda cyangwa kubangamira ibikorwa
bya gisirikare.
33. Nta kintu na kimwe mu bikubiye muri iyi ngingo
cyangwa mu ngingo ya 37, igika cya mbere, agace ka
d) kigamije kubangamira amategeko mpuzamahanga
asanzwe yemewe muri rusange akurikizwa mu
bijyanye n’ubutasi cyangwa mu bijyanye
n’ikoreshwa ry’amabendera mu ntambara zibera mu
nyanja.

articles.heading: Ibererekerwa Birabujijwe gutegeka ko hatagira abarokoka mu bo muhanganye, cyangwa gukora imirwano mu
articles.text: mugambi wo kubamaraho.

articles.heading: Gutabara umwanzi utakiri mu mirwano 1. Nta muntu n’umwe wemewe cyangwa wagombye kwemerwa bitewe n’imimerere arimo, nk’utakiri mu
articles.text:
mirwano ugomba kugabwaho ibitero.
2. Umuntu aba atakiri mu mirwano iyo:
a) ari mu maboko y’igihugu gihanganye n’ikindi;
b) yagaragaje ku buryo busobanutse ko ashaka
kuyamanika;
c) yataye ubwenge cyangwa yatakaje ubushobozi
bitewe n’ibikomere cyangwa uburwayi, bityo akaba
adashobora kwirwanaho; apfa kuba, muri iyo
mimerere yose,adakora igikorwa cyose kigirira nabi
umwanzi kandi atagerageza gutoroka.
3. Iyo abantu barebwa n’uburenganzira bwo
kurengerwa nk’imfungwa z’intambara baguye mu
maboko y’umwanzi mu buryo butamenyerewe
bw’imirwano butuma kubahungisha nk’uko
biteganywa mu Cyiciro cya I cy’Igice cya III
cy’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ya III
bidashoboka,bagomba kurekurwa kandi hagafatirwa
ingamba zose zishoboka mu kubacungira umutekano.

articles.heading: Abari mu ndege 1. Nta muntu umanukira mu mutaka avuye mu ndege iri mu kaga ugomba kuraswa igihe amanuka
articles.text:
2. Akigera ku butaka bugenzurwa n’igihugu
gihanganye n’ikindi, umuntu umanukiye mu mutaka
asimbutse mu ndege iri mu kaga, agomba guhabwa
uburyo bwo kwishyira mu maboko y’umwanzi mbere
yo kugabwaho igitero, keretse bigaragaye ko yinjiye
mu bikorwa by’uburwanyi.
3.Ingabo zisimbutse mu ndege mu rwego rw’igitero
ntizirengerwa n’iyi ngingo.
ICYICIRO CYA II: UKO ABARWANYI
N’IMFUNGWA Z’INTAMBARA BAFATWA

articles.heading: Ingabo 1. Ingabo z’igihugu kiri mu ntambara zigizwe n’ingabo zose, amatsinda yose cyangwa imitwe yose
articles.text:
ifite intwaro kandi ikorera kuri gahunda, ikuriwe
n’ubuyobozi bushobora kubazwa imyitwarire y’abo
bukuriye imbere y’icyo gihugu, kabone nubwo icyo
gihugu cyaba gihagarariwe na guverinoma cyangwa
umutegetsi utemerwa n’igihugu gihanganye n’ikindi.
Muri izo ngabo hagomba kubamo urwego rushinzwe
imyitwarire, mu byo rushinzwe hakabamo
iyubahirizwa rw’amategeko mpuzamahanga
akurikizwa mu ntambara.
2. Abagize ingabo z’ighugu kiri mu ntambatra (uretse
abakozi bo mu rwego rw’ubuvuzi n’abo mu rwego
rw’idini bavugwa mu ngingo ya 33 y’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya III) ni abarwanyi, ni ukuvuga ko
bafite uburenganzira bwo kugira uruhare rutaziguye
mu mirwano.
3. Igihugu kiri mu ntambara cyinjije mu ngabo zacyo
urwego rwunganira igisirikare cyangwa ishami rya
gisirikare rishinzwe ibijyanye n’iyubahirizwa
ry’amategeko mu gisirikare, kigomba kubimenyesha
ibindi bihugu biri muri iyo ntambara.

articles.heading: Abarwanyi n’imfungwa z’intambara 1. Umurwanyi wese, nk’uko bisobanurwa mu ngingo ya 43, uguye mu maboko y’igihugu gihanganye
articles.text:
n’ikindi aba imfungwa y’intambara
2. Nubwo abarwanyi bose basabwa kubahiriza
amahame y’amategeko mpuzamahanga akurikizwa
mu ntambara, kutayubahiriza ntibyambura
umurwanyi uburenganzirabwo gufatwa
nk’umurwanyi, cyangwa uburenganzira bwo gufatwa
nk’imfungwa y’intambara igihe afashwe n’umwanzi,
uretse mu bihe biteganywa mu gika cya 3 n’icya 4.
3. Mu rwego rwo kurushaho kurengera abaturage
b’abasivili ingaruka z’imirwano, abarwanyi bagomba
kwitandukanya n’abasivili igihe bagaba igitero
cyangwa bari mu bikorwa bya gisirikare bitegura
igitero. Icyakora hitawe ku kuba hari imimerere ibaho
mu ntambara aho bitewe n’imiterere y’imirwano,
umurwanyi ufite intwaro atabasha kwitandukanya
n’abaturage b’abasivili, akomeza gufatwa
nk’umurwanyi, apfa gusa kuba muri iyo mimerere,
atwara intwaro ku mugaragaro ;
a) muri buri gikorwa cya gisirikare; no
b) no mu gihe ashobora kubonwa n’umwanzi ari mu
ngendo zerekeza mu birindiro zibanziriza igabwa
ry’igitero agomba kugira mo uruhare.
Ibikorwa bitanyuranyije n’ibiteganywa n’iki gika
ntibifatwa nk’ubushukanyi buvugwa mu ngingo ya
37, igika cya mbere, agace ka c).
4.Umurwanyi uwo ari we wese ufashwe n’uruhande
bahanganye atujuje ibisabwa biteganywa mu nteruro
ya kabiri y’igikacya 3 atakaza uburenganzira bwe
bwo gufatwa nk’imfungwa y’intambara, ariko
arengerwa kimwe n’izindi mfungwa z’intambara mu
buryo buteganywa mu Masezerano Mpuzamahanga
ya III ndetse no muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera.
Uko kurengerwa gukubiyemo ukurengerwa guhabwa
imfungwa z’intambara hashingiwe ku Masezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya III mu gihe umuntu nk’uwo
aciriwe urubanza kandi agahanirwa icyaha cyose
yaba yakoze.
5. Umurwanyi uwo ari we wese ufashwe n’uruhande
bahanganye kandi atari mu gitero cyangwa mu
bikorwa bya gisirikare bitegura igitero ntatakaza
uburenganzira bwo gufatwa nk’umurwanyi no
gufatwa nk’imfungwa y’intambara, bitewe
n’ibikorwa yaba yarakoze mbere yaho.
6. Iyi ngingo ntawe ivutsa uburenganzira bwo
gufatwa nk’imfungwa y’intambara hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 4 y’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya III.
7. Iyi ngingo ntihindura imigirire y’ibihugu yemewe
muri rusange, irebana no kwambara impuzankano ku
barwanyi bakorera mu matsinda y’ingabo za Leta
zambaye impuzankano y’igihugu kiri mu ntambara.
8. Uretse ibyiciro by’abantu bivugwa mu ngingo ya
13 y’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ya I n’aya II,
abagize ingabo z’igihugu kiri mu ntambara, nk’uko
basobanurwa mu ngingo ya 43 y’aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera, bafite uburenganzira bwo kurengerwa
mu buryo buteganywa n’ayo Masezerano
Mpuzamahanaga iyo bakomeretse cyangwa barwaye,
cyangwa hakurikijwe Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga
ya II iyo barohamye mu nyanja cyangwa mu yandi
mazi.

articles.heading: Kurengerwa kw’abantu bagize uruhare mu mirwano 1. Umuntu wagize uruhare mu mirwano akagwa mu
articles.text:
maboko y’uruhande bahanganye afatwa
nk’imfungwa y’intambara, akarengerwa
n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ya III mu gihe
asabye gufatwa nk’imfungwa y’intambara, cyangwa
agaragara ko afite uburenganzira bwo gufatwa
nk’imfungwa y’intambara, cyangwa uruhande
yarwaniraga rubimusabiye binyuze mu
kubimenyesha igihugu cyamufashe cyangwa igihugu
kirengezi. Mu gihe hari ugushidikanya ku bijyanye no
kumenya niba umuntu nk’uwo afite uburenganzira
bwo gufatwa nk’imfungwa y’intambara, uwo muntu
akomeza gufatwa nka yo bityo agakomeza
kurengerwa n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ya III
n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, kugeza igihe urukiko
rubifitiye ububasha rugennye uko agomba gufatwa.
2. Iyo umuntu ufashwe mpiri n’igihugu bahanganye
ntafatwe nk’imfungwa y’intambara ahubwo akaba
agomba kuburanishwa n’icyo gihugu ku cyaha
gifitanye isano n’imirwano, agira uburenganzi bwo
gusaba ko uburenganzira bwe bwo kwitwa imfungwa
y’intambara bwemerwa imbere y’urukiko kandi
ikibazo cye kigasuzumwa. Igihe cyose uburyo
bw’imiburanishirize bukurikizwa bubyemera, icyo
kibazo kigomba gusuzumwa mbere y’uko
aburanishwa ku cyaha ashinjwa. Abahagarariye
igihugu kirengezi bafite uburenganzira bwo
gukirikira urubanza ikibazo cye gisuzumirwamo,
uretse mu mimerere idasanzwe aho rushobora
kuburanishirizwa mu muhezo ku mpamvu
z’umutekano w’igihugu. Muri icyo gihe, igihugu
kimufite kigomba kubimenyesha igihugu kirengezi.
3. Umuntu uwo ari we wese wagize uruhare mu
mirwano akaba adafite uburenganzira bwo gufatwa
nk’imfungwa y’intambara kandi hakaba nta ngingo
zimubereye kurushaho zimurengera mu Masezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya IV, agumana mu bihe byose
uburenganzira bwo kurengerwa n’ingingo ya 75
y’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera. Ku butaka
bw’igihugu bwafashwe, umuntu nk’uwo, uretse igihe
afungiwe ubutasi, ahabwa na none, bitabangamiye
ibikubiye mu ngingo ya 5 y’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya IV, uburenganzira mu
by’itumanaho buteganywa n’ayo Masezerano.

articles.heading: Intasi 1. Bitabangamiye ingingo iyo ari yo yose y’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga cyangwa y’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, umwe mu bagize ingabo
articles.text:
z’igihugu ufashwe n’igihugu bahanganye ari mu
bikorwa by’ubutasi ntagira uburenganzira bwo
gufatwa nk’imfungwa y’intambara, ahubwo ashobora
gufatwa nk’intasi.
2. Umwe mu bagize ingabo z’igihugu kiri mu
ntambara ukusanya cyangwa ugerageza gukusanya
amakuru mu nyungu z’icyo gihugu abikorera mu ku
butaka bw’igihugu bugenzurwa n’igihugu
bahanganye, ntafatwa nk’uwishoye mu bikorwa
by’ubutasi iyo ibyo bikorwa yabikoze yambaye
impuzankano y’ingabo z’igihugu cye.
3. Umwe mu bagize ingabo z’igihugu kiri mu
ntambara utuye ku butaka bw’igihugu bwafashwe
n’igihugu bahanganye, ukusanya cyangwa ugerageza
gukusanya, mu nyungu z’igihugu akomokamo,
amakuru yo mu nyungu za gisirikare kuri ubwo
butaka, ntafatwa nk’uwishoye mu bikorwa
by’ubutasi, keretse igihe abikora yiyoberanyije
cyangwa yihishe. Nanone uwo muturage ntatakaza
uburenganzira bwe bwo gufatwa nk’imfungwa
y’intambara kandi ntashobora gufatwa nk’intasi,
keretse gusa iyo afatiwe mu bikorwa by’ubutasi.
Byongeye kandi uwo muturage ntatakaza
uburenganzira bwe bwo gufatwa nk’imfungwa
y’intambara kandi ntashobora gufatwa nk’intasi,
keretse gusa iyo afatiwe mu bikorwa by’ubutasi.
4. Umwe mu bagize ingabo z’igihugu kiri mu
ntambara udatuye ku butaka bw’igihugu bugenzurwa
n’igihugu bahanganye wishoye mu bikorwa
by’ubutasi kuri ubwo butaka atakaza uburenganzira
bwe bwo gufatwa nk’imfungwa y’intambara kandi
akaba yafatwa nk’intasi ari uko gusa afashwe
atarasubira mu ngabo asanzwe abarizwamo.

articles.heading: Abacancuro 1. Umucancuro nta burenganzira afite bwo gufatwa nk’umurwanyi cyangwa nk’imfungwa y’intambara
articles.text:
2. Umucancuro bivuga umuntu wese:
a) wahawe mu buryo bwihariye akazi mu gihugu
abamo cyangwa avanywe mu mahanga ko kurwana
mu ntambara ;
b) ugira koko uruhare rutaziguye mu mirwano ;
c) ugira uruhare mu mirwano agambiriye kubona
inyungu ku giti cye kandi akaba koko
yarasezeranyijwe n’uruhande ruri mu ntambara
ubwarwo cyangwa mu izina ryarwo, igihembo
gifatika kirenze icyo basezeranya cyangwa icyo
bahemba abarwanyi bahuje urwego n’imirimo bo mu
ngabo z’icyo gihugu;
d) udakomoka mu gihugu kiri mu ntambara cyangwa
ku butaka bugenzurwa n’igihugu kiri mu ntambara;
e) utari mu ngabo z’igihugu kiri mu ntambara; n’
f) utaroherejwe n’igihugu kindi kitari ikiri mu
ntambara mu butumwa buzwi nk’umwe mu ngabo
z’icyo gihugu.
IGICE CYA IV: ABATURAGE B’ABASIVILI
ICYICIRO I: Ukurengerwa rusange ku ngaruka
z’imirwano
UMUTWE WA I:Amategeko y’ibanze n’aho
akurikizwa

articles.heading: Amategeko y’ibanze Mu rwego rwo kwita ku kubaha no ku kurengerwa kw’abaturage b’abasivili n’imitungo ya gisivili
articles.text:
ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bigomba buri gihe
gutandukanya abaturage b’abasivili n’abarwanyi,
bikanatandukanya imitungo ya gisivili n’intego za
gisirikare, kandi ibikorwa bya gisirikare byabyo
bikibasira gusa intego za gisirikare.

articles.heading: Igisobanuro cy’ijambo ibitero n’aho rikoreshwa 1. “igitero”bivuga ibikorwa byose by’urugomo
articles.text:
biboneje ku wo muhanganye, byaba bikozwe mu
rwego rwo gutera cyangwa kwirwanaho.
2.Ibiteganywa muri aya Masezerano birebana
n’ibitero, bikurikizwa ku bitero byose hatitawe ku
butaka byabereyeho, harimo n’ibikorewe ku butaka
bw’igihugu kiri mu ntambara ariko bugenzurwa
n’igihugu bihanganye.
3.Ibiteganywa muri iki Cyiciro bikurikizwa mu
bikorwa byose by’intambara yo ku butaka, mu kirere
cyangwa mu nyanja bishobora kugira ingaruka ku
baturage b’abasivili, ku bantu b’abasivili no ku
bikorwa bya gisivili ku butaka. Bikoreshwa kandi ku
bitero byo mu mazi cyangwa byo mu kirere bigabwe
ku ntego za gisirikare ziri ku butaka, ariko
ntibihungabanye amategeko mpuzamahanga
akurikizwa mu ntambara ibera mu nyanja cyangwa
mu kirere.
4. Ibiteganywa muri iki Cyiciro byuzuza amabwiriza
arebana no kurengera ikiremwamuntu akubiye mu
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga ya IV, by’umwihariko
mu Mutwe wa II wayo, no mu yandi masezerano
mpuzamahanga areba ibihugu biri muri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera, kimwe n’andi mahame
y’amategeko mpuzamahanga arebana no kurinda
abasivili n’imitungo ya gisivili ingaruka z’imirwano
ibera ku butaka, mu nyanja no mu kirere.
UMUTWE WA II: Abantu b’abasivili
n’abaturage b’abasivili

articles.heading: Igisobanuro cy’abantu b’abasivili n’abaturage b’abasivili 1. Umusivili ni muntu wese utabarirwa muri kimwe
articles.text:
mu byiciro bivugwa mu ngingo ya 4 A. igika cya
mbere, icya 2, icya 3 n’icya 6 by’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya III no mu ngingo ya 43 y’aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera. Mu gihe habayeho
gushidikanya niba umuntu ari umusivili, uwo muntu
afatwa nk’umusivili.
2. Abaturage b’abasivili bagizwe n’abantu bose
b’abasivili.
3. Kuba mu baturage b’abasivili harimo abantu
bamwe batabarirwa mu bantu b’abasivili ntibibuza
abo baturage gukomeza gufatwa nk’abasivili.

articles.heading: Kurengera abaturage b’Abasivili 1. Abaturage b’abasivili n’abantu b’abasivili bagomba kurindwa muri rusange ingaruka z’ibikorwa
articles.text:
bya gisirikare. Amabwiriza akurikira, yiyongera ku
yandi mabwiriza y’amategeko mpuzamahanga
akurikizwa, agomba kwitabwaho mu bihe byose,
kugira ngo ubwo burinzi butangwe mu buryo
buhamye.
2. Abaturage b’abasivili kimwe n’abantu b’abasivili
ku giti cyabo ntibagomba kugabwaho ibitero.
Ibikorwa byose by’urugomo cyangwa ibikangisho
byabyo bigamije mbere na mbere gukwirakwiza
icyoba mu baturage b’abasivili birabujijwe.
3. Abantu b’abasivili barengerwa n’ibiteganywa muri
iki Cyiciro, uretse gusa mu gihe bafite uruhare mu
mirwano mu buryo butaziguye.
4. Ibitero bitarobanura birabujijwe. Ijambo “igitero
kitarobanura” rivuga:
a) ibitero bitaboneje ku ntego ya gisirikare yihariye;
b)ibitero bikoresha uburyo n’ibikoresho
by’intambara bidashobora kubonezwa ku ntego ya
gisirikare yihariye;
c) ibitero bikoresha uburyo cyangwa ibikoresho
bigira ingaruka zitagira umupaka nk’uko bisabwa
muri aya Masezerano;bityo uko byagenda kose
bikaba bidashobora gutandukanya intego za
gisirikare n’abantu b’abasivili cyangwa imitungo ya
gisivili.
5. Ibitero bikurikira bibarirwa mu cyiciro cya bimwe
mu bitero bitarobanura:
a) igitero cyo kurasa ibisasu hakoreshejwe uburyo
ubwo ari bwo bwose cyangwa ibikoresho ibyo ari byo
byose, kigamije gusenya icyarimwe umubare runaka
w’intego za gisirikare zitegeranye kandi
zitandukanye ziri mu mugi, mu nsisiro, mu midugudu
cyangwa ahandi hose hatuye abantu b’abasivili
benshi cyangwa hari imitungo ya gisivili myinshi,
nk’aho ari intego ya gisirikare imwe ;
b) igitero gishobora kwitegwa ko cyahitana ubuzima
bw’abasivili, cyabakomeretsa, cyakwangiza
imitungo ya gisivili cyangwa kigateza ibyo
byose,birenze urugero ugereranyije n’inyungu za
gisirikare zifatika kandi zitaziguye zitezwe muri icyo
gitero.
6. Birabujijwe kugaba ibitero byo kwihorera ku
baturage b’abasivili cyangwa ku bantu b’abasivili.
7.Kuba ahantu hari abaturage b’abasivili cyangwa
abantu b’abasivili cyangwa urujya n’uruza rwabo
ntibishobora gukoreshwa mu gukingira ahantu
hamwe na hamwe cyangwa uduce tumwe na tumwe
ibikorwa bya gisirikare, by’umwihariko hagamijwe
gukingira intego za gisirikare ngo zidaterwa,
cyangwa gukingira, korohereza cyangwa
kubangamira ibikorwa bya gisirikare. Ibihugu
bihanganye mu ntambara ntibigomba kuyobora
urujya n’uruza rw’abaturage b’abasivili cyangwa
abantu b’abasivili mu buryo bugamije gukingira
intego za gisirikare ngo zidaterwa cyangwa gukingira
ibikorwa bya gisirikare.
8. Kurenga ku bibujijwe muri iyi ngingo
ntibivaniraho ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara
inshingano zabyo imbere y’amategeko ku bijyanye
n’abaturage b’abasivili n’abantu b’abasivili, harimo
n’inshingano yo gufata ingamba z’ubushishozi
ziteganywa n’ingingo ya 57.
UMUTWE WA III. IMITUNGO YA GISIVILI

articles.heading: Kurengera imitungo ya gisivili muri rusange 1. Imitungo ya gisivili ntigomba kugabwaho ibitero
articles.text:
cyangwa kwangizwa mu rwego rwo kwihorera.
Imitungo ya gisivili ni imitungo yose idafatwa
nk’intego za gisirikare nk’uko isobanurwa mu gika
cya 2.
2. 2. Ibitero bigomba kubonezwa gusa ku ntego za
gisirikare. Ku birebana n’imitungo, intego za
gisirikare zigarukira ku mitungo, ku bw’imiterere
yayo, aho iherereye, icyo yagenewe cyangwa icyo
ikoreshwa, itera inkunga igaragara igikorwa cya
gisirikare kandi isenywa ryayo rya burundu cyangwa
igice cyayo, ifatwa ryayo cyangwa kuyibuza
urwinyagamburiro bitanga by’umwihariko amahirwe
adashidikanywa ya gisirikare.
3. Mu gihe hariho ugushidikanya ku bijyanye no
kumenya niba umutungo wagenewe ubusanzwe
ibikorwa bya gisivili, urugero nk’aho basengera, inzu
cyangwa indi nyubako yo guturamo cyangwa ishuri,
urimo ukoreshwa mu gushyigikira igikorwa cya
gisirikare, uwo mutungo ugomba gufatwa
nk’utarakoreshwa mu gikorwa cya gisirikare.

articles.heading: Kurengera imitungo ndangamuco n’insengero Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n’Amasezerano y’i La Haye yerekeye kurengera umutungo ndangamuco mu
articles.text:
gihe cy’intambara yo ku wa 14 Gicurasi 1954
n’ibiteganywa mu yandi masezerano mpuzamahanga
abigenga, birabujijwe:
a) gukora igikorwa cyose cy’imirwano kigamije
kwibasira inzibutso z’amateka, ibihangano
by’ubugeni cyangwa ahantu hasengerwa habarirwa
mu murage ndangamuco cyangwa ndangakwemera
w’ibihugu;
b) gukoresha iyo mitungo mu gutera ingabo mu
bitugu igisirikare
c) kwibasira iyo mitungo mu rwego rwo kwihorera.

articles.heading: Kurinda ibikoresho bya ngombwa ku buzima bw’abaturage b’abasivili 1. Birabujijwe kwicisha abasivili inzara nk’uburyo
articles.text:
bwo kurwana intambara.
2. Birabujijwe gutera, gusenya, gukuraho ibintu bya
ngombwa ku buzima bw’abaturage b’abasivili
cyangwa gutuma bidakomeza kugira akamaro,
nk’ibiribwa n’uduce duhingwamo ibyo biribwa,
imyaka, amatungo, amariba n’ibigega by’amazi meza
n’ibikorwa remezo byo kuhira, hagamijwe kubivutsa
abaturage b’abasivili cyangwa igihugu gihanganye
n’ikindi bitewe n’agaciro kabyo mu kubungabunga
ubuzima, hatitawe ku mpamvu bishingikirijeho, yaba
ari iyo gushonjesha abantu b’abasivili, gutuma bava
aho bari, cyangwa indi mpamvu iyo ari yo yose.
3.Ibuzwa riteganywa mu gika cya 2 ntirikurikizwa ku
bintu bivugwamo bikoreshwa n’igihugu gihanganye
n’ikindi:
a) ku bikenewe byo kubeshaho gusa abagize ingabo
zacyo ;cyangwa
b) niba atari nk'uburyo bwo kwibeshaho, noneho mu
gushyigikira mu buryo butaziguye ibikorwa bya
gisirikare, hashingiwe ariko ko nta na hamwe
ibikorwa byibasiye ibyo bintu byafashwe bishobora
gusigira abaturage b'abasivili ibiryo cyangwa amazi
bidahagije kugeza aho bitera inzara, cyangwa
bigatuma bahunga.
4. Ibyo bintu ntibigomba kwibasirwa hagamijwe
kwihimura.
5. Hitawe ku bisabwa bya ngombwa kuri buri gihugu
kiri mu ntambara mu kurinda ko ubutaka bwacyo
bwigarurirwa, igihugu kiri mu ntambara gishobora
kurenga ku bibujijwe mu gika cya 2 ku butaka buri
mu maboko yacyo iyo bibaye ngombwa kubera
impamvu zikomeye za gisirikare.

articles.heading: Ukurengera ibidukikije bya kamere 1. Abarwana mu ntambara bagomba kwita ku kurengera ibidukikije kamere birinda ko
articles.text:
byakwangirika ahantu hanini, ku buryo bukabije
kandi burambye. Muri uko kubirengera, birabujijwe
kandi gukoresha uburyo n’ibikoresho by’intambara
byakorewe guteza, cyangwa bikekwa ko byateza
bene iryo yangirika ry’ibidukikije kamere, bityo
bigashyira mu kaga ubuzima cyangwa kubaho
by’abaturage.
2. Ibitero byo kwihorera byibasira ibidukikije bya
kamere birabujijwe.

articles.heading: Ukurengerwa kw’ibikorwa n’inyubako bibitse ingufu zateza ibyago 1. Ibikorwa remezo cyangwa inganda bibitse ingufu
articles.text:
z’umurengera zateza ibyago, nk’ingomero, inkuta
zikumira amazi n’inganda zitunganya amashanyarazi
mu ngufu za nikereyeri, ntibigomba kugabwaho
ibitero, kabone nubwo byaba ari intego za gisirikare,
niba ibyo bitero byatuma birekura ingufu
z’umurengera zateza ibyago, bityo bigahitana
ubuzima bwa benshi cyangwa bikangiza byinshi mu
baturage b’abasivili.
Ibindi bintu bifatwa nk’intego za gisirikare biri kuri
ibyo bikorwa cyangwa inyubako cyangwa hafi
yabyo, ntibigomba kugabwaho ibitero iyo ibyo bitero
byatuma ibyo bikorwa cyangwa inyubako birekura
inguzu z’umurengera zateza ibyago, bityo bigahitana
ubuzima bwa benshi cyangwa bikangiza byinshi mu
baturage b’abasivili.
2.Ukurengerwa kwihariye kuvugwa mu gika cya
mbere gushobora guhagarara:
a) ku rugomero cyangwa urukuta rukumira amazi,
igihe byaba bikoreshejwe mu bindi bitari ibyo
bisanzwe bikoreshwamo no mu gutera inkunga
igisirikare mu buryo buhoraho, bufatika kandi
butaziguye, kandi kubigabaho ibitero bikaba ari bwo
buryo bwonyine bushoboka bwo guhagarika iyo
nkunga ;
b) ku ruganda rutunganya amashanyarazi
hifashishijwe ingufu za nikereyeri, iyo rutanga
amashanyarazi mu rwego rwo gushyigikira ku buryo
buhoraho, bufatika kandi butaziguye ibikorwa bya
gisirikare kandi ibyo bitero bikaba ari bwo buryo
bwonyine bushoboka bwo guhagarika iyo nkunga ;
c) ku zindi ntego za gisirikare ziri kuri ibyo bikorwa
cyangwa inyubako cyangwa se hafi yabyo, niba gusa
zikoreshwa mu gutera inkunga ibikorwa bya
gisirikare ku buryo buhoraho, bufatika kandi
butaziguye, kandi ibyo bitero bikaba ari bwo buryo
bwonyine bushoboka bwo guhagarika iyo nkunga ;
3. Mu mimerere yose yavuzwe, abaturage b’abasivili
n’abantu b’abasivili bakomeza kurengerwa mu buryo
bwose bagenwa n’amategeko mpuzamahanga,
harimo n’ukurengerwa gushingiye ku ngamba
z’ubushishozi ziteganywa n’ingingo ya 57. Iyo
ukurengerwa guhagaze bikaba ngombwa ko
igikorwa, inyubako cyangwa ikintu gifatwa nk’intego
ya gisirikare bivugwa mu gika cya mbere biterwa,
hagomba gufatwa ingamba z’ubushishozi zose za
ngombwa mu kwirinda isandara ry’ingufu
z’umurengera zateza ibyago.
4. Kugaba ibitero kuri kimwe mu bikorwa, ku
nyubako cyangwa ku ntego ya gisirikare bivugwa mu
gika cya mbere mu rwego rwo kwihimura
birabujijwe.
5. Ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bigomba
kwihatira kudashyira ikintu gishobora gufatwa
nk’intego ya gisirikare hafi y’ibikorwa cyangwa
inyubako bivugwa mu gika cya mbere. Icyakora
inyubako zishyizweho mu rwego rwo kurinda ibitero
ibikorwa cyangwa inyubako birengerwa ziremewe,
kandi ntizigomba kugabwaho ibitero, igihe cyose
zidakoreshwa mu mirwano, uretse gusa mu bikorwa
byo kwirwanaho bya ngombwa byakorwa hagamijwe
gusubiza ibitero byagabwa kuri ibyo bikorwa
cyangwa inyubako birengerwa, kandi intwaro
zahashyizwe ntizirenge izikenewe mu gusubizayo
igikorwa cy’umwanzi uteye ibyo bikorwa cyangwa
inyubako.
6. Ibihugu biri muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bihamagarirwa
gukorana andi masezerano agamije kurushaho
kurengera ibintu birimo ingufu zateza ibyago.
7. Mu koroshya imenyekanisha ry’ibintu birengerwa
n’iyi ngingo, ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara
bishobora kubigaragaza bikoresheje ikimenyetso
cyihariye kigizwe n’inziga eshatu zifite ibara
ry’icunga rikeye zishyirwa ku ruhembe rumwe
nk’uko bigaragazwa mu ngingo ya 16 y’Umugereka
wa I w’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera. Kuba icyo
kimenyetso kitariho ntibigabanya na busa inshingano
z’igihugu cyose kiri mu ntambara zishingiye kuri iyi
ngingo.
UMUTWE WA IV: INGAMBA
Z’UBUSHISHOZI

articles.heading: Ubushishozi mu kugaba igitero 1. Ibikorwa bya gisirikare bigomba kuyoborwa hitabwa igihe cyose ku kurokora abaturage
articles.text:
b’abasivili, abantu b’abasivili n’imitungo ya gisivili.
2. Ku birebana n’ibitero, ingamba zikurikira zigomba
gufatwa:
a) abategura cyangwa abafata icyemezo cyo gutera
bagomba:
i) gukora ibishoboka byose mu kureba ko bitagiye
kugabwa ku basivili cyangwa ku mitungo ya gisivili,
cyangwa ku bintu birengerwa mu buryo bwihariye,
ahubwo ko aho bigiye kugabwa ari ku ntego za
gisirikare nk’uko zisobanurwa mu gika cya 2
cy’ingingo ya 52, kandi ko iterwa ry’izo ntego
ritabujijwe muri aya Masezerano;
ii) gufata ingamba zose zishoboka mu gihe bihitamo
ibikoresho n’uburyo bikoreshwa mu gitero
hagamijwe kwirinda kwica, gukomeretsa abasivili
cyangwa kwangiza imitungo ya gisivili ku buryo
butagenderewe, cyangwa se kubigabanya uko
bishoboka kose.
iii) kwirinda kugaba igitero cyitezweho ko cyateza,
mu buryo butagenderewe, imfu z’abasivili,
cyakomeretsa abasivili, cyakwangiza ibikorwa bya
gisivili, cyangwa se kigateza ibyo byose, birenze
urugero ugereranyije n’inyungu za gisirikare zifatika
kandi zitaziguye zitezwe muri icyo gitero.
b) igitero kigomba kurekwa cyangwa kigahagarikwa
iyo bigaragaye ko icyo kigamije kwibasira atari
intego ya gisirikare cyangwa ko ari ikintu kirengerwa
mu buryo bwihariye, cyangwa bikekwa ko icyo gitero
cyateza, mu buryo butagambiriwe, imfu z’abasivili,
cyakomeretsa abasivili, cyakwangiza ibikorwa bya
gisivili, cyangwa se kigateza ibyo byose, birenze
urugero ugereranyije n’inyungu za gisirikare zifatika
kandi zitaziguye zitezwe muri icyo gitero;
c) mu gihe cy’igitero gishobora kugira ingaruka ku
baturage b’abasivili, hagomba gutangwa integuza
mbere y’igihe kandi mu buryo nyabwo,uretse igihe
imimerere y’ibintu itabyemera.
3. Iyo bishoboka guhitamo hagati y’intego za
gisirikare nyinshi zishobora kugabwaho igitero
bigatanga inyungu zimwe mu rwego rwa gisirikare,
intego babona ko yagabwaho igitero bikagira
ingaruka nkeya ku bantu b’abasivili cyangwa ku
mitungo ya gisivili ni yo bagomba guhitamo.
4.Mu kuyobora ibikorwa bya gisirikare mu nyanja
cyangwa mu kirere, buri gihugu kiri mu ntambara
kigomba, hakurikijwe uburenganzira n’inshingano
bishingiye ku mategeko mpuzamahanga akurikizwa
mu ntambara, gufata ingamba zose zumvikana mu
kwirinda imfu z’abaturage b’abasivili n’iyangizwa
ry’imitungo ya gisivili.
5. Nta na kimwe mu biteganywa muri iyi ngingo
gishobora gufatwa nk’icyemera igabwa ry’ibitero ku
baturage b’abasivili, ku bantu b’abasivili cyangwa ku
mitungo ya gisivili.

articles.heading: Ingamba zo kugabanya ingaruka z’ibitero Mu buryo bwose bushoboka, ibihugu biri mu ntambara bigomba
articles.text:
a) kwihatira, bitabangamiye ingingo ya 49
y’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanaga ya kane, kwigiza
kure abaturiye ibintu bya gisirikare, abaturage
b’abasivili, abantu b’abasivili n’ibintu bya gisivile
biri aho bigenzura;
b) kwirinda gushyira intego za gisirikare mu duce
dutuwe cyane cyangwa hafi yatwo;
c) gufata izindi ngamba za ngombwa mu kurinda
ingaruka z’ibikorwa bya gisirikare abaturage
b’abasivili, abantu b’abasivili n’imitungoya gisivili
biri aho bagenzura.
UMUTWE WA V : UDUCE N’UTURERE
BIRENGERWA KU BURYO BWIHARIYE

articles.heading: Uduce tutarinzwe 1. Birabujijwe ku bihugu biri mu ntambara kugaba ibitero, hakoreshejwe uburyo ubwo ari bwo bwose,
articles.text:
ku duce tutarinzwe.
2. Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bw’igihugu kiri
mu ntambara bushobora gutangaza ko agace kose
gatuwe kari hafi y’akarere ingabo zirasaniranamo
cyangwa hafi yako, ari agace katarinzwe igihugu
bahanganye cyemerewe kuba cyafata. Ako gace
kagomba kuba kujuje ibi bikurikira:
a) kuba abarwanyi bose kimwe n’intwaro
n’ibikoresho bya gisirikare byimukanwa byahakuwe;
b) inyubako cyangwa ibigo bya gisirikare
bitimukanwa bihari ntibigomba gukoreshwa mu
kurwanya umwanzi;
c) abayobozi n’abaturage ntibakora ibikorwa
by’imirwano;
d) nta gikorwa gitera inkunga ibikorwa bya gisirikare
kigomba kuhakorerwa.
3. Kuba muri ako gace hari abantu barengerwa ku
buryo bwihariye hakurikijwe Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, no
kuba hari abapolisi baharekewe bashinzwe gusa
kubahiriza amategeko no kubumbatira ituze,
ntibinyuranyije n’ibisabwa bivugwa mu gika cya 2.
4. Itangazo rikozwe hakurikijwe igika cya 2 rigomba
gushyikirizwa igihugu bgihanganye n’ikindi kandi
rigomba kugaragaza no kwerekana, mu buryo
busobanutse uko bishoboka kose, imbibi z’agace
katarinzwe. Igihugu kiri mu ntambara cyakiriye iryo
tangazo kigomba kumenyesha ko cyaribonye
kikanafata ako gace nk’agace katarinzwe, uretse gusa
igihe ibisabwa bivugwa mu gika cya 2 byaba
bitubahirijwe, aho kigomba guhita kibimenyesha
igihugu cyakoze iryo tangazo.
Nubwo ako gace kaba katubahirije ibisabwa bivugwa
mu gika cya 2, gakomeza kurengerwa hakurikijwe
izindi ngingo ziteganywa muri aya Masezerano
y’inyongera no mu yandi mategeko mpuzamahanga
akurikizwa mu ntambara.
5. Ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bishobora
kugirana amasezerano yerekeye ishyirwaho ry’uduce
tutarinzwe nubwo utwo duce twaba tutujuje ibisabwa
bivugwa mu gika cya 2. Amasezerano bigiranye
agomba kugaragaza no kwerekana, mu buryo
busobanutse uko bishoboka kose, imbibi z’agace
katarinzwe, byaba ngombwa agashyiraho uburyo
bwo kugenzura iyubahirizwa ryayo muri ako gace.
6. Igihugu gifite mu nshingano zacyo agace karebwa
n’ayo masezerano kigomba kukagaragaza uko
bishoboka kose,gikoresha ibimenyetso
cyumvikanyeho n’ikindi gihugu, bigashyirwa ahantu
bishobora kugaragara neza, cyane cyane ku
muzenguruko no ku mbibi zako kimwe no ku
mihanda y’ingenzi.
7. Agace kareka gufatwa nk’agace katarinzwe iyo
katacyujuje ibisabwa biteganywa mu gika cya 2
cyangwa mu masezerano avugwa mu gika cya 5.
No muri icyo gihe ariko, ako gace gakomeza
kurengerwa hakurikijwe izindi ngingo ziteganywa
muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera no mu yandi
mategeko mpuzamahanga akurikizwa mu ntambara.

articles.heading: Uturere tutarangwamo ibikorwa bya gisirikare 1.Birabujijwe ku bihugu biri mu ntambara kwagurira
articles.text:
ibikorwa bya gisirikare mu turere byumvikanyeho,
mu masezerano, ko ari uturere tutarangwamo
ibikorwa bya gisirikare, iyo uko kutwaguriramo
ibikorwa bya gisirikare kunyuranyije n’ibikubiye
muri ayo masezerano.
2. Ayo masezerano agomba kuba agaragaza neza
ubushake bwa buri ruhande, kandi ashobora gukorwa
mu mvugo cyangwa mu nyandiko, mu buryo
butaziguye cyangwa binyuze ku gihugu kirengezi
cyangwa undi muryango w’ubutabazi utabogamye,
kandi ashobora kuba akozwe mu buryo
bw’amatangazo ahuye yakozwe n’impande zombi.
Ayo masezerano ashobora gukorwa no mu gihe
cy’amahoro kimwe na nyuma y’itangira
ry’imirwano, kandi agomba kugaragaza no
kwerekana, mu buryo busobanutse uko bishoboka
kose, imbibi z’akarere katarangwamo ibikorwa bya
gisirikare, byaba ngombwa agashyiraho uburyo bwo
kugenzura iyubahirizwa ryayo muri ako karere.
3. Impamvu ya bene ayo Masezerano igomba kuba
mu buryo busanzwe ari ugushyiraho akarere kujuje
ibisabwa bikurikira:
a) kuba abarwanyi bose kimwe n’intwaro
n’ibikoresho bya gisirikare byimukanwa byahakuwe;
b) inyubako cyangwa ibigo bya gisirikare
bitimukanwa bihari ntibigomba gukoreshwa mu mu
mirwano;
c) abayobozi n’abaturage ntibakora ibikorwa
by’imirwano;
d) igikorwa cyose gifitanye isano no gushyigikira
ingabo kigomba kuba cyahagaze.
Ibihugu biri mu ntambara bigomba kumvikana ku
buryo bwo gusobanura ibisabwa bivugwa mu gace ka
(d) no ku bantu bemererwa kugera mu karere
katarangwamo ibikorwa bya gisirikare, biyongera ku
bavugwa mu gika cya 4.
4. Kuba muri ako karere hari abantu barengerwa ku
buryo bwihariye hakurikijwe Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, no
kuba hari abapolisi baharekewe bashinzwe gusa
kubahiriza amategeko no kubumbatira ituze,
ntibinyuranyije n’ibisabwa bivugwa mu gika cya 3.
5. Igihugu gifite mu nshingano zacyo ako karere
kigomba kukagaragaza uko bishoboka kose,
gikoresheje ibimenyetso, cyumvikanyeho n’ikindi
gihugu, bigashyirwa ahantu bishobora kugaragara
neza, cyane cyane ku muzenguruko no ku mbibi zako
kimwe no ku mihanda y’ingenzi.
6. Mu gihe imirwano isatiriye akarere katarangwamo
ibikorwa bya gisirikare, kandi ibihugu bihanganye
mu ntambara bikaba byaragiranye amasezerano kuri
icyo kibazo, nta na kimwe muri byo gishobora
gukoresha ako karere mu bintu bijyanye no kuyobora
ibikorwa bya gisirikare, cyangwa ngo gitangaze
cyonyine ko kiretse gufata ako karere
nk’akatarangwamo ibikorwa bya gisirikare.
7. Iyo kimwe mu bihugu bihanganye mu ntambara
kinyuranyije bikomeye n’ibikubiye mu gika cya 3
cyangwa icya 6, ikindi gihugu ntigikomeza kurebwa
no kubahiriza inshingano ziva ku masezerano
yatumye akarere kitwa akarere katarangwamo
ibikorwa bya gisirikare. Muri icyo gihe, ako karere
kareka gufatwa gutyo, ariko kagakomeza kurengerwa
n’izindi ngingo ziteganywa muri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera no mu yandi mategeko mpuzamahanga
akurikizwa mu ntambara.
UMUTWE WA VI: KURENGERA ABASIVILI

articles.heading: Ibisobanuro n’aho bikoreshwa Muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
Ukurengerwa ku buryo bwa rusange 1. Inzego zishinzwe kurinda abasivili kimwe n’abakozi bazo bagomba kubahwa no kurengerwa,
articles.text:
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri aya Masezerano y’
Inyongera, by’umwihariko muri iki Cyiciro. Bafite
uburenganzira bwo gukora imirimo yabo yo kurinda
abasivili, uretse mu gihe babibujijwe n’impamvu
zikomeye za gisirikare.
2. Ibiteganywa mu gika cya mbere binareba abasivili,
nubwo baba batari mu bagize inzego zishinzwe
kurinda abasivili, bitabira impuruza y’abayobozi
babifitiye ububasha, bagakora imirimo yo kurinda
abasivili bagenzuwe n’abo bayobozi.
33.Inyubako n’ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu kurinda
abasivili kimwe n’ubwihisho bugenewe abaturage
b’abasivili bigengwa n’ingingo ya 52. Ibintu
bikoreshwa mu kurinda abasivili ntibishobora
kwangizwa cyangwa gukoreshwa ibyo bitagenewe,
keretse bikozwe n’igihugu kibifite nk’ibyacyo.

articles.heading: Kurinda abasivili mu turere twafashwe 1. Ku butaka bw’ighugu bwafashwe, abayobozi bagomba korohereza inzego za gisivili zishinzwe
articles.text:
kurinda abasivili gukora imirimo yazo. Nta na rimwe
abakozi bazo bashobora guhatirwa gukora ibindi
bikorwa byabangamira imirimo yabo. Igihugu
cyahafashe ntigishobora guhindura imiterere y’izo
nzego cyangwa abakozi bazo ku buryo byatuma
zituzuza inshingano zazo ku buryo bunoze.Izo nzego
ntizigomba gusabwa kwita mbere na mbere ku
benegihugu b’icyo gihugu cyangwa ku nyungu
zacyo.
2. Igihugu cyafashe ubutaka bw’ikindi ntikigomba
guhatira, gutegeka cyangwa gushishikariza inzego za
gisivili zirinda abasivili gukora imirimo yazo mu
buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose bwabangamira inyungu
z’abaturage b’abasivili.
3. Igihugu cyafashe ubutaka bw’ikindi gishobora ku
mpamvu z’umutekano, kwambura intwaro abakozi
b’uburinzi bwa gisivili.
4. Igihugu cyafashe ubutaka bw’ikindi gishobora
guhindura mu mikorere isanzwe no gusaba inyubako
cyangwa ibikoresho by’imiryango yo kurengera
abasivili cyangwa bikoreshwa n’iyo miryango igihe
uko guhindura cyangwa gusaba bibangamiye
abaturage b’abasivili.
5. Igihugu cyafashe ubutaka bw’ikindi gishobora
gusaba cyangwa guhindura uburyo bwacyo, ku buryo
gikomeza kubahiriza amabwiriza rusange yateguwe
mu gika cya 4 hitabwa ku buryo bwihariye
bukurikira:
a) kuba inyubako cyangwa ibikoresho ari ngombwa
mu kwita ku bindi bintu bikenewe n’abaturage
b’abasivili;
b) no kuba kubyitiza cyangwa kubikoresha mu bindi
bitazamara igihe kirenze icyo bikenewemo.
6. Igihugu cyafashe ubutaka bw’ikindi ntigishobora
kujyana mu bindi cyangwa kwitiza ubwihisho
bwashyiriweho abaturage b’abasivili cyangwa
bukenewe n’abo baturage.

articles.heading: Inzego za gisivili zirinda abasivili z’ibihugu bidafite aho bibogamiye cyangwa bidafite uruhare mu ntambara n’imiryango
articles.text:
mpuzamahanga zihuriyemo
1. Ingingo ya 62, iya 63, iya 65 n’iya 66 zikurikizwa
na none ku bakozi no ku bikoresho by’inzego za
gisivili zirinda abasivili z’ibihugu bidafite aho
bibogamiye cyangwa z’ibindi bihugu bidafite uruhare
mu ntambara zikorera imirimo yo kurengera abasivili
ivugwa mu ngingo ya 61 ku butaka bw’igihugu kiri
mu ntambara, zarabyemerewe kandi zigenzurwa
n’icyo gihugu. Itangwa ry’ubwo bufasha rigomba
kumenyeshwa vuba bishoboka igihugu gihanganye
n’iikindi bireba.Nta na rimwe icyo gikorwa kizafatwa
nko kwivanga mu ntambara.Icyakora icyo gikorwa
kigomba gukorwa hitabwa uko bikwiye ku
kutabangamira inyungu z’umutekano w’ibihugu biri
mu ntambara birebwa n’icyo gikorwa.
2. Ibihugu biri mu ntambara bibonye ubufasha
buvugwa mu gika cya mbere n’ibihugu biri muri aya
Masezerano bitanga ubwo bufasha byagombye
korohereza, iyo bikenewe, ihuzwa ry’ibyo bikorwa
byo kurinda abasivili ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Muri
icyo gihe, ibiteganywa muri uyu Mutwe
binakurikizwa ku miryango mpuzamahanga
ibishinzwe.
3. Ku butaka bw’igihugu bwafashwe, igihugu
cyabufashe ntigishobora gukuramo cyangwa
kugabanya ibikorwa by’imiryango ya gisivili yo
kurengera abasivili b’ibihugu bidafite aho
bibogamiye cyangwa ibindi bihugu bitari mu
ntambara n’imiryango mpuzamahanga y’ubuyobozi
niba bishobora kuzuza neza inshingano zo kurengera
abasivili mu buryo bwacyo cyangwa ubw’akarere
kafashwe.

articles.heading: Ihagarara ry’ukurengerwa 1. Ukurengerwa kw’inzego za gisivili zishinzwe kurinda abasivili, ukw’abakozi, inyubako, ubwihisho
articles.text:
n’ibikoresho byazo ntigushobora guhagarara uretse
igihe bikoze cyangwa byifashishijwe mu gukora
ibikorwa bibangamiye umwanzi, bitari mu nshingano
z’izo nzego. Icyakora ukurengerwa kw’izo nzego
gushobora gukurwaho ari uko gusa zibanje guhabwa
umuburo, zikanahabwa igihe ntarengwa gishyize mu
gaciro igihe cyose bikwiye, nyamara ntizite kuri uwo
muburo.
2. Imimerere ikurikira ntifatwa nk’ibikorwa bigirira
nabi umwanzi:
a) kuba imirimo yo kurinda abasivili iyobowe
cyangwa igenzurwa n’abategetsi ba gisirikare;
b) kuba abakozi b’inzego zishinzwe kurinda abasivili
bafatanya n’abasirikare mu kuzuza inshingano zo
kurinda abasivili, cyangwa kuba abasirikare batijwe
inzego zishinzwe kurinda abasivili;
c) kuba imirimo yo kurinda abasivili yagera ku buryo
butunguranye no ku basirikare bahungabanyijwe
n’intambara, by’umwihariko abatagishobora kugira
uruhare mu mirwano.
3. Na none kandi kuba abakozi b’urwego rushinzwe
kurinda abasivili bitwaje intwaro zoroheje
zigendanwa mu rwego rwo kubumbatira ituze no
kwirwanaho ntigomba gufatwa nk’igikorwa kigirira
nabi umwanzi. Icyakora, mu turere tuberamo
imirwano yo ku butaka cyangwa aho ishobora kubera,
ibihugu biri mu ntambara bigomba gufata ingamba
zikwiye zibemerera gukoresha gusa intwaro zo mu
ntoki, nka masotera cyangwa revoruveri, kugira ngo
gutandukanya abakozi bashinzwe kurinda abasivili
n’abarwanyi byorohe. Ariko nubwo abakozi
bashinzwe kurinda abasivili baba bitwaje izindi
ntwaro zoroheje muri utwo duce, bagomba gukomeza
kubahwa no kurengerwa uhereye igihe
bamenyekaniye ko ari bo.
4. Kuba inzego za gisivili zishinzwe kurinda
abaturage zifite imitunganyirize nk’iy’inzego za
gisirikare no kuba gukora uwo murimo ari itegeko
ntibivanaho ukurengerwa zemererwa n’ibiteganywa
muri uyu Mutwe.

articles.heading: Kugaragaza 1. Buri gihugu kiri mu ntambara kigomba kwihatira gukora ku buryo inzego zishinzwe kurinda abasivili,
articles.text:
abakozi bazo, inyubako zazo n’ibikoresho byazo
bigira ibibiranga bigaragara igihe bikoreshwa gusa
mu mirimo yo kurinda abasivili.Ubwihisho
bwashyiriweho abaturage b’abasivili na bwo
bwagombye kugira ibiburanga.
2. Buri Gihugu kiri mu ntambara kigomba na none
kwihatira kwemeza no gushyira mu bikorwa uburyo
n’amabwiriza bifasha kuranga ubwihisho
bwashyiriweho abasivili, kimwe n’abakozi, inyubako
n’ibikoresho by’inzego zishinzwe kurinda abasivili
biriho ikirango mpuzamahanga cyihariye cy’imirimo
yo kurinda abasivili.
3. Ku butaka bw ‘igihugu bwafashwe no mu duce
turimo tuberamo imirwano cyangwa utwo imirwano
ishobora kwadukamo igihe icyo ari cyo cyose,
abakozi b’inzego zishinzwe kurinda abasivili
bagombye kugaragazwa n’ikirango cyihariye
cy’imirimo yo kurinda abasivili cyemewe ku rwego
mpuzamahanga, n’ikarita ibaranga ihamya abo ari bo.
4. Ikirango mpuzamahanga cyihariye cy’imirimo yo
kurinda abasivili kigizwe n’ishusho ya mpandeshatu
ndinganire y’ubururu iri mu ibara risa n’icunga igihe
gikoreshejwe mu kurengera inzego zishinzwe
kurinda abasivili, abakozi bazo, inyubako zazo
n’ibikoresho byazo, ndetse no mu kurinda ubwihisho
bwa gisivili.
5. Uretse icyo kirango cyihariye, ibihugu biri mu
ntambara bishobora no kumvikana ku ikoreshwa
ry’ibindi bimenyetso byihariye mu kugaragaza
inzego zishinzwe kurinda abasivili.
6.Ikurikizwa ry’ibiteganywa kuva ku gika cya mbere
kugeza ku cya 4 rigengwa n’Umutwe ya V
w’Umugereka wa I w’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera.
7. Mu gihe cy’amahoro, ikirango cyihariye
gisobanurwa mu gika cya 4 gishobora gukoreshwa
mu kugaragaza inzego zishinzwe kurinda abasivili,
byumvikanyweho n’abayobozi b’ibihugu babifitiye
ububasha.
8. Ibihugu biri muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bigomba gufata
ingamba za ngombwa mu kugenzura ikoreshwa
ry’ikirango mpuzamahanga gitandukanya mu
kurengera abasivili, kukirinda no guhana
imikoreshereze mibi yacyo.
9. Ibiranga abakozi bo mu buvuzi n’abo mu rwego
rw’idini, amavuriro n’uburyo bwo gutwara abantu
n’ibikoresho byo mu buvuzi by’inzego zishinzwe
kurinda abasivili na byo bigengwa n’ingingo ya 18.

articles.heading: Abari mu ngabo n’amatsinda ya gisirikare bashyizwe mu nzego zishinzwe kurengera abasivili 1. Abari mu ngabo n’amatsinda ya gisirikare
articles.text:
bashyizwe mu nzego zishinzwe kurengera abasivili
bagomba kubahwa kandi bakarindwa, icya ngombwa
akaba ari uko:
a) abo bakozi n’ayo matsinda baba barashinzwe ku
buryo buhoraho gukora iyo ari yo yose mu mirimo
ivugwa mu ngingo ya 61 kandi bakaba ari yo bakora
gusa;
b) abo bakozi, iyo bamaze gushyirwaho, badakora
izindi nshingano izo ari zo zose za gisirikare mu gihe
cy’intambara;
c) abo bakozi batandukanywa neza n’abandi bari mu
ngabo binyuze mu kwambara ku buryo bugaragara
neza ikirango mpuzamahanga cyihariye cyo kurinda
abasivili, kigomba kuba ari kinini bihagije, kandi abo
bakozi bakitwaza ikarita ibaranga iteganywa mu
Mutwe wa V w’Umugereka wa I w’aya Masezerano
yInyongera, ihamya abo ari bo ;
d) abo bakozi n’ayo matsinda bitwaza gusa intwaro
zigendanwa zoroheje bifashisha mu rwego rwo
kubumbatira ituze no kwirwanaho ku giti cyabo.
Ibiteganywa mu gika cya 3 cy’ingingo ya 65 na byo
birakurikizwa muri icyo gihe ;
e) abo bakozi batagira uruhare rutaziguye mu
mirwano kandi ntibakore cyangwa ngo bakoreshwe
ibikorwa bigirira nabi igihugu cy’umwanzi
binyuranye n’inshingano zabo zo kurinda abasivili;
f) abo bakozi n’ayo matsinda bakorera inshingano
zabo zo kurinda abasivili ku butaka bw’igihugu
cyabo gusa.
Kutubahiriza ibiteganywa mu gace e) haruguru ku
muntu uri mu ngabo wese urebwa n’ibigomba
kubahirizwa bivugwa mu duce a) na b) birabujijwe.
2. Iyo abasirikare bakorera mu nzego zishinzwe
kurinda abasivili bafashwe n’igihugu cy’umwanzi,
bafatwa nk’imfungwa z’intambara. Ku butaka
bw’igihugu bwafashwe, bashobora gukoreshwa mu
kurinda abasivili igihe bikenewe, ariko bigakorwa
gusa mu nyungu z’abaturage b’abasivili bo kri ubwo
utaka, icyangombwa akaba ari uko bakora iyo mirimo
ku bushake bwabo, iyo iyo mirimo ishobora kubateza
ibyago.
3. Inyubako n’ibintu by’agaciro by’ibikoresho
n’uburyo bw’ingendo z’amatsinda ya gisirikare
yashyizwe mu miryango irengera abasivili bigomba
kugaragazwa neza n’ikimenyetso mpuzamahanga
kiranga ku kurengera abasivili. Icyo kimenyetso
kigomba kuba kinini uko bikenewe.
4. Inyubako n’ibikoresho by’amatsinda ya gisirikare
yashyizwe ku buryo buhoraho mu nzego zishinzwe
kurinda abasivili kandi byagenewe gusa gukoreshwa
mu bikorwa byo kurinda abasivili, iyo bifashwe
n’igihugu cy’umwanzi, bikomeza kugengwa
n’amategeko y’intambara. Icyakora, uretse mu gihe
hamaze gufatwa ingamba zikwiriye mu kwita ku byo
abaturage b’abasivili bakeneye, ibyo bikoresho
ntibishobora guhindurirwa icyo bigenewe ngo
bikoreshwe ibindi bitajyanye n’imirimo yo kurinda
abasivili igihe cyose bigikenewe muri iyo mirimo,
keretse gusa mu gihe habayeho impamvu zikomeye
za gisirikare.
ICYICIRO CYA II: UBUTABAZI
BUKORERWA ABATURAGE B’ABASIVILI

articles.heading: Ibirebwa n’iki cyiciro Ibiteganywa muri iki Cyiciro bikurikizwa ku baturage b’abasivili nk’uko basobanurwa muri aya
articles.text:
Masezerano y’Inyongera, kandi bikuzuza ingingo ya
23, iya 55, iya 59, iya 60 n’iya 62 n’izindi ngingo
bijyanye zo mu Masezerano Mpuzamahanga ya IV.

articles.heading: Ibintu by’ibanze bikenewe ku butaka bw’igihugu bwafashwe 1. Hejuru y’inshingano zigaragazwa mu ngingo ya 55
articles.text:
y’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ya IV zijyanye
n’itangwa ry’ibiribwa n’imiti, igihugu cyafashe
ubutaka bw’ikindi kigomba gutanga, mu mikoro
yacyo yose kandi nta vangura iryo ari ryo ryose
rirenganya, ibyambarwa, ibiryamirwa, aho kwikinga,
kimwe n’ibindi bintu bya ngombwa ku buzima
bw’abaturage b’abasivili bo ku butaka bwafashwe,
ndetse n’ibikoresho bya ngombwa bijyanye
n’iyobokamana.
2. Ibikorwa by’ubutabazi bw’ibanze bukorerwa
abaturage b’abasivili bo ku butaka bwafashwe
bigengwa n’ingingo ya 59, iya 60, iya 61, iya 62, iya
108, iya 109, iya 110 n’iya 111 z’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya IV, kimwe n’ingingo ya 71 y’aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera, kandi bigomba gukorwa
bidatinze.

articles.heading: Ibikorwa by’ubutabazi 1.Iyo abaturage b’abasivili bo ku butaka bugenzurwa n’igihugu kiri mu ntambara, butari ubwafashwe,
articles.text:
badahawe ku buryo buhagije ibikoresho n’ibindi
bintu biteganywa mu ngingo ya 69, hakorwa ibikorwa
by’ubutabazi bigamije kubarengera kandi
bitabogamye, bizira ivangura iryo ari ryo ryose
rirenganya, bibanje kwemerwa n’ibihugu birebwa
n’ibyo bikorwa by’ubutabazi. Ubusabe bwo
kwemererwa gukora ibyo bikorwa by’ubutabazi
ntibushobora gufatwa nko kwivanga mu ntambara
cyangwa nko kurwanya uruhande uru n’uru. Mu gihe
cy’itangwa ry’imfashanyo z’ubutabazi, hitabwa
mbere na mbere ku bantu Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya IV cyangwa aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera ateganya ko bagomba kwitabwaho
cyangwa kurengerwa ku buryo bwihariye nk’abana,
abagore batwite cyangwa ababyeyi bari ku kiriri
n’abonsa.
2. Ibihugu biri mu ntambara na buri gihugu kiri muri
aya Masezerano y’Inyongera bigomba kwemera no
korohereza itambutswa ryihuse nta nkomyi
ry’ibyoherejwe nk’imfashanyo, ibikoresho n’abakozi
by’ubutabazi bitanzwe hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri
iki Cyiciro, ndetse n’igihe izo mfashanyo zigenewe
abaturage b’abasivili b’igihugu bihanganye.
3. Ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara na buri gihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera byemeye
itambuka ry’imfashanyo, ibikoresho n’abakozi
by’ubutabazi hakurikijwe igika cya 2 :
a) bigira uburenganzira bwo gushyiraho amabwiriza
akurikizwa mu itambutswa ryabyo, harimo nko
gutegeka ko ibyo bintu bitambutswa ari uko bibanje
kugenzurwa ;
b) bishobora kwemera ko izo mfashanyo zitambuka
ari uko gusa byemewe ko itangwa ryazo aho
zijyanywe rizagenzurwa n’igihugu kirengezi;
c) ntibishobora, mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose,
kuyobereza izo mfashanyo ahandi cyangwa gutinza
iyoherezwa ryazo, uretse mu gihe bikenewe
byihutirwa mu nyungu z’abaturage b’abasivili bireba.
4. Ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bigomba kwita
ku mutekano w’imfashanyo z’ubutabazi zoherezwa
kandi bikanafasha kugira ngo zitangwe vuba.
5. Ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara na buri gihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera birebwa
n’icyo kibazo, bigomba gushyigikira no korohereza
uburyo bwo guhuza ku rwego mpuzamahanga
ibikorwa by’ubutabazi bivugwa mu gika cya mbere.

articles.heading: Abakozi bagira uruhare mu bikorwa by’ubutabazi 1. Aho bikenewe, imfashanyo itangwa mu rwego
articles.text:
rw’ubutabazi ishobora kuba ikubiyemo kohereza
abakozi b’ubutabazi, cyane cyane abakora imirimo
yo gutwara imfashanyo no kuzishyikiriza abo
zigenewe, ikoreshwa ry’abo bakozi rigomba kubanza
kwemezwa n’igihugu bagiye gukoreramo.
2. Abo bakozi bagomba kubahwa kandi
bakarengerwa.
3. Buri gihugu cyakiriye imfashanyo z’ubutabazi
kigomba gukora ibishoboka byose kigafasha abakozi
bavugwa mu gika cya mbere kurangiza neza
ubutumwa bwabo bw’ubutabazi. Impamvu zikomeye
za gisirikare ni zo zonyine zishobora gutuma
ibikorwa by’ubutabazi byabo bigabanywa cyangwa
ingendo zabo zigahagarikwa by’agateganyo.
4. Nta na rimwe abakozi b’ubutabazi bagomba
kurenga imbibi z’ubutumwa bwabo hakurikijwe aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera. Bagomba by’umwihariko
kubahiriza ibisabwa n’umutekano w’igihugu
bakoreramo imirimo yabo. Ubutumwa bw’abakozi
bw’ubutabazi butubahiriza ibyo bushobora
guhagarikwa.
ICYICIRO CYA III : KWITA KU BANTU BARI
MU BUBASHA BW’IGIHUGU KIRI MU
NTAMBARA
UMUTWE WA I: Aho bikurikizwa no kurengera
abantu n’ibintu

articles.heading: Aho bikurikizwa Ibiteganywa muri iki Cyiciro byuzuza amategeko ajyanye no kurengera abasivili n’imitungo ya gisivili
articles.text:
biri mu maboko y’igihugu kiri mu ntambara akubiye
mu Masezerano Mpuzamahanga ya IV,
by’umwihariko mu Gice cya I n’icya III byayo,
kimwe n’andi mahame akurikizwa y’amategeko
mpuzamahanga yerekeye kurinda uburenganzira
bw’ibanze bwa muntu mu gihe cy’intambara iri ku
rwego mpuzamahanga.

articles.heading: Impunzi n'abantu badafite ubwenegihugu Abantu mberey’itangira ry’imirwano, bafatwaga nk’abatagira igihugu cyangwa nk’impunzi
articles.text:
hakurikijwe amasezerano mpuzamahanga yemewe
n’ibihugu birebwa cyangwa amategeko y’igihugu
cyabakiriye cyangwa batuyemo bafatwa, igihe cyose
kandi nta vangura rirenganya, nk’abantu barengerwa
hakurikijwe Igice cya I n’icya III by’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya IV.

articles.heading: Guhuza imiryango yatatanye Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara byorohereza mu
articles.text:
buryo bwose bushoboka ihuzwa ry’abagize
umuryango batatanye bitewe n’intambara kandi
bigashyigikira ibikorwa by’imiryango y’ubutabazi
ikora uwo murimo ikurikije ibiteganywa mu
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga no muri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera n’amabwiriza y’umutekano
y’ibyo bihugu.

articles.heading: Icyizere shingiro 1. Mu gihe abantu bari mu maboko y’igihugu kiri mu ntambara badateganyirijwe ingingo zibarengera
articles.text:
zibabereye kurushaho mu Masezerano
Mpuzamahanga no muri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera, bagezweho n’imimerere ivugwa mu
ngingo ya mbere y’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera,
bafatwa kimuntu mu bintu byose kandi bakemererwa
nibura kurengerwa mu buryo buteganywa n’iyi
ngingo nta vangura rirenganya, nk’irishingiye ku
bwoko, ku ibara ry’uruhu, ku gitsina, ku rurimi, ku
idini cyangwa imyemerere, ku bitekerezo bya politiki
cyangwa ibindi bitekerezo, ku gihugu cyangwa
icyiciro umuntu akomokamo, ku bukungu, ku
mavuko cyangwa indi mimerere, cyangwa ikindi
cyose kimeze nk’ibyo. Buri gihugu kigomba kubaha
agaciro, icyubahiro, imyizerere n’imigenzo yo mu
rwego rw’idini by’abo bantu bose.
2. Ibikorwa bikurikira, byaba bikozwe n’abasivili
cyangwa abasirikare, birabujijwe mu gihe cyose
n’ahantu hose:
a) Ihohotera ribangamira ukubaho, ubuzima
n’imibereho myiza ku mubiri cyangwa mu mutwe
by’abantu, by’umwihariko:
i) ubwicanyi
ii) ibikorwa by’iyicarubozo ibyo ari byo byose, byaba
ibyo ku mubiri cyangwa mu bitekerezo;
iii) ibihano bibabaza umubiri; no
iv) guca umuntu ibice by’umubiri;
b) ibikorwa bitesha agaciro umuntu, by’umwihariko
ibikorwa byo kumukoza isoni kandi bimutesha
agaciro, gushorwa mu buraya ku gahato n’ibindi
bikorwa by’urukozasoni;
c) gufata abantu ho ingwate;
d) ibihabo bitanzwe mu kivunge;no
e) gukangisha abantu gukorerwa igikorwa icyo ari
cyo cyose mu bikorwa byavuzwe haruguru.
3. Umuntu wese ufashwe, ufunzwe by’agateganyo
cyangwa ucumbikiwe kubera ibikorwa bifitanye
isano n’intambara, agomba kumenyeshwa bidatinze,
mu rurimi yumva, impamvu afatiwe ibyo byemezo.
Uretse iyo bafashwe cyangwa bafunzwe
by’agateganyo bakurikiranyweho ibyaha, abo bantu
bagomba kurekurwa bidatinze, kandi uko byagenda
kose, bagahita barekurwa impamvu zatumye bafatwa,
bafungwa cyangwa bacumbikirwa zikimara kuvaho.
4. Nta gihano gishobora gutangwa no gushyirwa mu
bikorwa ku wahamwe n’icyaha gifitanye isano
n’intambara, keretse yaragihamijwe n’urukiko
rutabogamye kandi rwashyizweho ku buryo
bukurikije amategeko, rwubahiriza amahame
y’imiburanishirize y’imanza yemewe muri rusange,
harimo aya akurikira:
a) amategeko y’imiburanishirize agomba kuba
yemerera ukekwa wese kumenyeshwa bidatinze
ibisobanuro birambuye bijyanye n’icyaha
akurikiranweho, kandi akamwemerera uburenganzira
n’uburyo bwose bwa ngombwa bwo kwiregura haba
mbere no mu gihe cy’iburanisha ;
b) ntawe ushobora guhanirwa icyaha atagizemo
uruhare ku giti cye;
c) ntawe ushobora gushinjwa cyangwa ngo acirwe
urubanza ku gikorwa cyangwa icyo atakoze
bitafatwaga nk’icyaha mu mategeko y’igihugu
cyangwa mu mategeko mpuzamahanga yakurikizwa
mu gihe cyakorwaga. Na none, nta wushobora
gukatirwa igihano kiremereye kuruta
icyateganywaga mu gihe icyaha cyakorwaga. Niba
nyuma y’ikorwa ry’icyaha, itegeko riteganyije
igihano cyoroheje, ni cyo uwakoze icyo cyaha
ahanishwa;
d) umuntu wese uregwa icyaha afatwa nk’umwere
kugeza igihe uruhare rwe rugaragajwe hakurikijwe
amategeko;
e) umuntu wese uregwa icyaha, afite uburenganzira
bwo kuburanishwa ahari;
f) ntawe ushobora guhatirwa kwishinja icyaha
cyangwa kwemera icyaha.
g) umuntu wese uregwa icyaha afite uburenganzira
bwo kubaza cyangwa gukoresha ibazwa
ry’abatangabuhamya bamushinja no kwemererwa
kuzana mu rubanza abatangabuhamya bamushinjura
kandi bakumvwa mu buryo bumwe n’abamushinja;
h) nta muntu ushobora gukurikiranwa cyangwa
guhanwa n’Igihugu kimwe ku
cyahayaburanishijweho ku rwego rwa nyuma
akagirwa umwere cyangwa agahamwa n’icyaha
hakurikijwe itegeko rimwe n’uburyo bumwe
bw’imiburanishirize;
i) umuntu wese ukurikiranyweho icyaha afite
uburenganzirabw’uko urubanza rwe rusomerwa mu
ruhame;
j) umuntu wese ukatiwe amenyeshwamu gihe
cy’ikatirwa rye,uburenganzira bwebwo kujurira
inzego z’ubutabera n’izindi nzego ashobora
kwitabaza kimwe n’ibihe ntarengwa bigomba
gukorwamo.
5. Abagore babujijwe ubwisanzure ku mpamvu
zifitanye isano n’intambara bacungirwa mu
byumbabitandukanye n’ibicungirwamo abagabo.
Bacungwa bya hafi n’abacunga imfungwa b’igitsina
gore.Icyakora iyo abagize umuryango bose bafunzwe
cyangwa bacumbikiwe, bacumbikirwa ahantu hamwe
nk’umuryango igihe cyose bishoboka.
6.Abantu bafashwe, bafunzwe cyangwa
bacumbikiwe ku mpamvu zifitanye isano
n’intambara barengerwa nk’uko biteganywa n’iyi
ngingo kugeza igihe barekuriwe, bashubirijwe mu
gihugu cyabo cyangwa bongeye gutuzwa, ndetse na
nyuma y’irangira ry’intambara.
7. Mu rwego rwo kwirinda ugushidikanya koseku
bijyanye n’ikurikiranwa n’iburanishwa ry’abantu
barengwa ibyaha by’intambara cyangwa ibyaha
byibasiye inyokomuntu, amahame akurikira agomba
gukurikizwa :
a) abantu baregwa ibyo byaha bagomba
gushyikirizwa ubutaberabagakurikiranwakandi
bakaburanishwa hakurikijwe amabwiriza
y’amategeko mpuzamahanga akurikizwa ;
b) umuntu wese utarengerwa n’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga cyangwa aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera mu buryo burenze ubuvugwa aha,
yitabwaho mu buryo buteganywa n’iyi ngingo,ibyaha
baregwa byaba bifatwa nk’ibyaha bikomeye byo
kurenga ku Masezerano Mpuzamahanga cyangwa
kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, cyangwa atari ko
bifatwa.
8. Nta na kimwe mu biteganywa muri iyi ngingo
gishobora gufatwa nk’ikigabanya cyangwa
ikibangamira indi ngingo yose y’amategeko
mpuzamahanga, irengera abantu bavugwa mu gika
cya mbere mu buryo burenze ubuteganyijwe muri iyi
ngingo.
UMUTWE WA II: INGAMBA ZIRENGERA
ABAGORE N’ABANA

articles.heading: Ukurengerwa kw’abagore 1. Abagore bagomba kubahwa mu buryo bwihariye kandi bakarindwa by’umwihariko gusambanywa ku
articles.text:
gahato, gukoreshwa uburaya ku gahato n’ibindi
bikorwa byose by’urukozasoni.
2. Ibirego by’abagore batwite n’abafite abana bato
bafashwe, bafunzwe by’agateganyo cyangwa
bacumbikiwe ku mpamvu zifitanye isano
n’intambara, bisuzumwa mbere y’ibindi.
3. Ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bigomba gukora
uko bishoboye kose ntibihanishe abagore batwite
cyangwa abafite abana bato igihano cyo kwicwa ku
cyaha gifitanye isano n’intambara.Igihano cyo
kwicwa gihawe bene abo bagore kuri ibyo byaha
ntigishobora gushyirwa mu bikorwa.

articles.heading: Ukurengerwa kw’abana 1. Abana bagomba kubahwa mu buryo bwihariye kandi bakarindwa ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose kiganisha
articles.text:
ku bikorwa by’urukozasoni. Ibihugu bihanganye mu
ntambara bigomba kubitaho bikanabaha ubufasha
bakeneye, bitewe n’ikigero cyabo cyangwa indi
mpamvu yashingirwaho.
2. Ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bigomba gufata
ingamba zose zishoboka ku buryo abana bari munsi
y’imyaka cumi n’itanu batagira uruhare rutaziguye
mu mirwano, kandi by’umwihariko, bikirinda
kubinjiza mu ngabo. Na none mu gihe byinjiza mu
ngabo abantu barengeje imyaka cumi n’itanu ariko
batarageza kuri cumi n’umunani, ibihugu bihanganye
mu ntambara bigomba kwibanda ku bakuze kurusha
abandi.
3. Iyo, mu buryo budasanzwe kandi budakurikije
ibiteganywa mu gika cya 2, abana bataruzuza imyaka
cumi n’itanu bagize uruhare rutaziguye mu mirwano
amaherezo bagafatwa n’igihugu gihanganye n’ikindi,
bakomeza kurengerwa mu buryo bwihariye nk’uko
biteganywa n’iyi ngingo, baba bafashwe
nk’imfungwa z’intambara cyangwa atari zo.
4. Iyo abana bafashwe, bafunzwe by’agateganyo
cyangwa bacumbikiwe ku mpamvu zifitanye isano
n’intambara, bagomba gucungirwa mu byumba
bitandukanye n’ibyo abantu bakuru bafungirwamo,
uretse aho abagize umuryango bose bacumbikirwa
hamwe nk’umuryango nk’uko biteganywa n’igika
cya 5 cy’ingingo ya 75.
5. Igihano cyo kwicwa gikatiwe abantu bari
bataruzuza imyaka cumi n’umunani igihe icyaha
cyabahamye cyakorwaga, ntigishobora gushyirwa
mu bikorwa.

articles.heading: Ihungishwa ry’abana 1. Nta gihugu kiri mu ntambara kigomba guhungishiriza abana batari abacyo mu kindi gihugu
Ingamba zo kurengera abanyamakuru 1. Abanyamakuru bari mu butumwa bw’akazi buteje akaga, mu turere tw’intambara bafatwa nk’abasivili
articles.text:
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 50 igika cya 1.
2. Barengerwa batyo hakurikijwe Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera,
igihe cyose badakora ikintu cyatuma bafatwa ukundi,
kandi bitabangamiye uburenganzira bw’abatara
amakuru y’intambara bakorera mu ngabo bwo
gufatwa mu buryo buteganywa n’ingingo ya 4 A.
y’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ya III.
3. Bashobora guhabwa ikarita ibaranga iteye kimwe
n’urugero ruri ku Mugereka wa II w’aya Masezerano.
Iyo karita, itangwa na Leta y’Igihugu umunyamakuru
akomokamo, icyo atuyemo cyangwa igihugu
igitangazamakuru akorera giherereyemo, yemeza ko
uyifite ari umunyamakuru.
IGICE CYA V: ISHYIRWA MU BIKORWA
RY’AMASEZERANO MPUZAMAHANGA
N’IRY’AYA MASEZERANO Y’INYONGERA
ICYICIRO CYA I: INGINGO RUSANGE

articles.heading: Ingamba z’ishyirwa mu bikorwa 1. Ibihugu biri muri aya Masezerano n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bigomba gufata bidatinze
articles.text:
ingamba zose za ngombwa zo gushyira mu bikorwa
inshingano bihabwa n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga
n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera.
2. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bitanga
amategeko n’amabwiriza yihariye mu kwita ku
iyubahirizwa ry’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga n’aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera bikanagenzura ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ryayo.

articles.heading: Ibikorwa by’Umuryango Utabara Imbabare n’indi miryango y’ubutabazi 1.Ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara byorohereza
articles.text:
Komite Mpuzamahanga y’Umuryango utabara
imbabare uko bibishoboye kose kugira ngo ibashe
gukora inshingano z’ubutabazi ihabwa
n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera hagamijwe kurengera no guha ubufasha
abahohoterwa n’intambara. Komite mpuzamahanga
y’Umuryango Utabara Imbabare ishobora na none
gukorera abo bahohoterwa n’intambara ibindi
bikorwa byose by’ubutabazi, ibanje kubyemererwa
n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara birebwa n’ibyo
bikorwa.
2. Ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara biha Imiryango
Itabara Imbabare (mu birango byose) yabyo ubufasha
bukenewe mu bikorwa byayo by’ubutabazi
bikorerwa abahohoterwa n’intambara, hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga n’aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera n’Amahame Shingiro
y’Umuryango Utabara Imbabare yashyizweho
n’Inama Mpuzamahanga z’Umuryango Utabara
Imbabare.
3. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara byorohereza, mu
buryo bwose bushoboka, itangwa ry’imfashanyo
Imiryango itabara imbabare y’Umusaraba
w’Umutuku (no mu bindi birango byayo byose)
n’Ihuriro ry’Imiryango Itabara Imbabare biha
abahohotewe n’intambara hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera n’Amahame Shingiro y’Umuryango
Utabara Imbabare yashyizweho n’Inama
Mpuzamahanga z’Umuryango Utabara Imbabare.
44. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara
bizatanga, uko bishoboka kose ubufasha bumeze
kimwe n’ubwavuzwe mu gika cya 2 n’icya 3 ku yindi
miryango y’ubutabazi iteganywa n’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera,
yemerewe n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bireba
kandi ikora ibikorwa byayo by’ubutabazi ikurikije
ibikubiye mu Masezerano Mpuzamahanga no muri
aya Masezerano y’Inyongera.

articles.heading: Abajyanama mu by’amategeko bo mu ngabo Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, igihe cyose, n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara mu
articles.text:
gihe cy’intambara, bigomba gukora ku buryo
abajyanama mu by’amategeko baboneka igihe
bakenewe ngo bagire inama abayobozi ba gisirikare
bari ku rwego rukwiye ku bijyanye n’ikurikizwa
ry’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera no ku bijyanye n’inyigisho zerekeranye
n’ayo masezerano zigomba guhabwa abari mu ngabo.

articles.heading: Imenyekanishwa ry’amasezerano 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byiyemeje, haba mu gihe cy’amahoro cyangwa mu gihe
articles.text:
cy’intambara, kumenyekanisha ku buryo bwagutse
uko bishoboka kose Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga
n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera mu bice byabyo
byose, by’umwihariko bikayinjiza mu nyigisho
zigenewe abasirikare, kandi bigashishikariza
abaturage b’abasivili kuyiga, ku buryo amenyekana
hose haba mu ngabo no mu baturage b’abasivili.
2. Mu gihe cy’intambara, abayobozi bose ba
gisirikare cyangwa aba gisivili baba bafite inshingano
zijyanye n’ikurikizwa ry’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera,
bagomba kuba basobanukiwe bihagije
ibiyakubiyemo.

articles.heading: Amategeko ashyira mu bikorwa aya Masezerano Ibihugu biri muri aya Masezerano bigomba kohererezanya hagati yabyo, vuba bishoboka,
articles.text:
bibinyujije k’ushinzwe kubika aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera, no ku bihugu birengezi aho bibaye
ngombwa, ihindurandimi ry’aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera mu ndimi zemewe mu butegetsi bwabyo,
kimwe n’amategeko n’amabwiriza bishobora kuba
byarashyizeho mu rwego rwo kuyashyira mu
bikorwa.
UMUTWE WA II: IHANWA RY’IBYAHA KU
MASEZERANO MPUZAMAHANGA
CYANGWA KURI AYA MASEZERANO
Y’INYONGERA

articles.heading: Ihanwa ry’ibyaha kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera 1. Ibikubiye mu Masezerano Mpuzamahanga birebana n’ihanwa ry’ibyaha bisanzwe n’ibyaha
articles.text:
bikomeye, byuzuzwa n’ibiteganywa n’iki Cyiciro, ni
byo bikurikizwa mu guhana ibyaha bisanzwe
n’ibyaha bikomeye byo kurenga kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera.
2. Ibikorwa bifatwa nk’ibyaha bikomeye mu
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga binafatwa nk’ibyaha
bikomeye muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera iyo
bikorewe abantu bari mu maboko y’igihugu
gihanganye n’ikindi barengerwa n’ingingo ya 44, iya
45, n’iya 73 z’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, cyangwa
bikorewe inkomere, abarwayi cyangwa abarohamye
b’igihugu gihanganye n’ikindi barengerwa n’aya
Masezerano yInyongera, cyangwa se bikorewe
abakozi bo mu rwego rw’ubuvuzi cyangwa rw’idini,
amavuriro cyangwa uburyo bwo gutwara abantu
n’ibintu bukoreshwa mu buvuzi,bigenzurwa
n’igihugu gihanganye n’ikindi kandi birengerwa
n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera.
3. Hejuru y’ibyaha bikomeye bisobanurwa mu
ngingo ya 11, ibikorwa bikurikira, iyo bikozwe
bigambiriwe, birenze ku ngingo zimwe na zimwe
z’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, kandi bigateza
urupfu cyangwa ibibazo bikomeye ku busugire
bw’umubiri cyangwa ku buzima, bifatwa nk’ibyaha
bikomeye muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera ;
a) kugaba igitero ku baturage b’abasivili cyangwa ku
bantu b’abasivili ;
b) kugaba igitero kitavangura abasirikare n’abasivili
ku buryo kigera ku baturage b’abasivili cyangwa ku
mitungo ya gisivili, ukigabye azi ko icyo gitero
kizahitana ubuzima bw’abantu benshi kigakomeretsa
abasivili benshi cyangwa kikangiza cyane imitungo
ya gisivili, nk’uko bisobanurwa mu ngingo ya 57,
igika cya 2 agace ka (a) iii) ;
c) kugaba igitero ku bikorwa n’inyubako bibitse
ingufu zateza ibyago ubikoze azi ko icyo gitero
kizahitana ubuzima bw’abantu benshi, kigakomeretsa
abasivili benshi cyangwa kikangiza cyane imitungo
ya gisivili, nk’uko bisobanurwa mu ngingo ya 57,
igika cya 2 agace ka (a) iii) ;
d) kugaba igitero ku duce tutarinzwe
n’ututarangwamo ibikorwa bya gisirikare;
e) kugaba igitero ku muntu ubikoze azi neza ko uwo
muntu atagifite uruhare mu mirwano;
f) gukoresha mu buryo bushukana, butubahirije
ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 37, ikirango cyihariye
cy’umusaraba utukura, igice cy’uruziga rutukura
cyangwa intare n’izuba bitukura n’ibindi birango
birengera byemewe n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga
cyangwa aya Masezerano y’Inyongera.
4. Hejuru y’ibyaha bikomeye bisobanurwa mu bika
bibanziriza iki no mu Masezerano Mpuzamahanga,
ibikorwa bikurikira bifatwa nk’ibyaha bikomeye
muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera iyo bikozwe
bigambiriwe kandi birenze ku Masezerano
Mpuzamahanga cyangwa kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera :
a) kwimurira igice cy’abaturage b’abasivili b’igihugu
cyafashe ubutaka bw’ikindi kuri ubwo butaka
cyafashe, cyangwa kwirukana cyangwa kwimurira
abaturage bose cyangwa igice cyabo bo ku butaka
bwafashwe ahandi hantu kuri ubwo butaka cyangwa
hanze yabwo binyuranyije n’ingingo ya 49
y’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ya IV.
b) gukerereza nta mpamvu yumvikana isubizwa
ry’imfungwa z’intambara cyangwa abasivili mu
bihugu byabo ;
c) ibikorwa by’ivanguraruhu bya apariteyidi n’ibindi
bikorwa bya kinyamaswa kandi bitesha umuntu
agaciro, birimo ibikorwa bihungabanya agaciro ka
muntu bishingiye ku ivanguramoko ;
d) kugaba igitero ku nzibutso ndangamateka,
ibihangano by’ubugeni cyangwa insengero byemewe
neza ko bigize umurage ndangamuco cyangwa
ndangamyemerere w’ibihugu kandi byashyizwe mu
birengerwa ku buryo bwihariye binyuze mu
masezerano yihariye, harimo nk’ayaba yarakozwe
mu rwego rw’umuryango mpuzamahanga
ubishinzwe, icyo gitero kikangiza bikomeye iyo
mitungo, kandi nta kimenyetso gihari cy’uko urundi
ruhande rwaba rwararenze ku ngingo ya 53 agace ka
b), kandi izo nzibutso ndangamateka, ibihangano
by’ubugeni cyangwa insengero bikaba bitegereye
intego za gisirikare;
e) kuvutsa umuntu urengerwa n’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga cyangwa uvugwa mu gika cya 2
cy’iyi ngingo uburenganzira bwe ku rubanza
rukurikije amategeko kandi rutabogamye.
5. Bitabangamiye ikurikizwa ry’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga n’iry’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera,
ibyaha bikomeye byo kurenga kuri aya masezerano
yose bifatwa nk’ibyaha by’intambara.

articles.heading: Kudakora ibitegetswe 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bigomba guhana ibyaha
articles.text:
bikomeye no gufata ingamba za ngombwa mu
guhagarika ibindi byaha byose, bishingiye ku
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga cyangwa kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera, bijyanye no kwirengagiza
gukora ibiri mu nshingano.
2. Kuba icyaha cyo kutubahiriza Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga cyangwa aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera cyarakozwe n’umukozi ufite
abamukuriye ntibivaniraho abamukuriye
uburyozwacyaha cyangwa gukurikiranwa mu rwego
rw’imyitwarire, bitewe n’uko ibintu bimeze, niba
baramenye cyangwa bari bafite amakuru
yashoboraga kubemeza, mu gihe ibintu byabaga, ko
uwo mukozi yarimo akora cyangwa yendaga gukora
icyaha nk’icyo, nyamara ntibafate ingamba zose
zishoboka zari mu bubasha bwabo, zo kuburizamo
cyangwa guhana icyo cyaha.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’abayobozi b’ingabo 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bigomba gushinga
articles.text:
abayobozi ba gisirikare gukumira ibyaha byo kurenga
ku Masezerano Mpuzamahanga no kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera mu ngabo bayoboye no mu
bandi bantu bashinzwe kugenzura, aho bibaye
ngombwa bakabihanira kandi bakabimenyesha
abayobozi babifitiye ububasha.
2. Mu rwego rwo gukumira no guhana ibyo byaha,
ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano n’ibihugu
bihanganye mu ntambara bigomba gutegeka
abayobozi b’ingabo zabyo, hakurikijwe urwego
bariho n’inshingano bafite, kureba ko ingabo
bayoboye zizi neza inshingano zihabwa
n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera.
3. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara bigomba
gutegeka umuyobozi wese w’ingabo wamenye ko
abo akuriye cyangwa abandi bantu ashinzwe
kugenzura bagiye gukora cyangwa bakoze icyaha cyo
kurenga ku Masezerano Mpuzamahanga cyangwa
kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, gufata ingamba
zose za ngombwa mu kuburizamo uko kurenga ku
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga cyangwa kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera, kandi byaba bikwiye,
agatangiza ikurikiranwa ry’abayarenzeho mu rwego
rw’imyitwarire cyangwa rw’inshinjabyaha.

articles.heading: Ubufatanye magirirane mu rwego rw’inshinjabyaha 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
articles.text:
bifatanya, mu buryo bwagutse uko bishoboka kose,
mu bijyanye n’ikurikirana ry’ibyaha bikomeye byo
kurenga kuri aya Masezerano Mpuzamahanga no kuri
aya Masezerano y’Inyongera.
2. Haseguriwe uburenganzira n’inshingano
biteganywa n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ndetse
n’ibiteganywa mu gika cya mbere cy’ingingo ya 85
y’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, ibihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, mu gihe imimerere
ibyemera, bigomba gufatanya mu bibazo bijyanye
n’ihererekanya ry’abakurikiranweho ibyaha. Byita
uko bikwiriye ku busabe bw’igihugu cyakorewemo
icyaha umuntu akekwaho.
3. Mu bibazo byose, hakurikizwa itegeko ry’igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano cyasabwe kohereza
ukekwaho icyaha. Icyakora ibikubiye mu bika
bibanziriza iki ntibibangamira inshingano zishingiye
ku ngingo z’andi masezerano hagati y’ibihugu bibiri
cyangwa byinshi agenga cyangwa yagenga ibintu
byose cyangwa igice cy’ibijyanye n’ubufatanye mu
butabera mu rwego rw’inshinjabyaha.

articles.heading: Ubufatanye Mu gihe habayeho habayeho kurenga ku Masezerano Mpuzamahanga cyangwa kuri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
y’Inyongera ku buryo bukomeye, ibihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera byiyemeje kugira
icyo bibikoraho, byaba byisunganye cyangwa buri
kimwe ukwacyo, mu bufatanye n’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye kandi mu buryo bukurikije
ibiteganywa n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga
ashyiraho Umuryango w’Abibumbye.

articles.heading: Komisiyo mpuzamahanga ishinzwe kugaragaza ibimenyetso ku byabaye 1. a) Hashyizweho Komisiyo mpuzamahanga
articles.text:
ishinzwe kugaragaza ibimenyetso, yiswe “
Komisiyo” mu ngingo zikurikira, igizwe n’abantu
cumi na batanu b’inyangamugayo ku rwego rwo
hejuru kandi bazwiho kutabogama.
b) Igihe nibura ibihugu makumyabiri mu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera bizaba bimaze
kwemera ububasha bwa Komisiyo hakurikijwe igika
cya 2, Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye azatumiza inama y’abahagarariye
ibyo bihugu kugira ngo itore abagize Komisiyo,
nyuma yaho ajye ayitumiza buri myaka itanu. Muri
iyo nama, abahagarariye ibyo bihugu batora abagize
Komisiyo mu ibanga ku rutonde rw’abakandida,aho
buri kimwe muri ibyo bihugu kiba gishobora gutanga
umukandida umwe mu ikorwa ry’urwo rutonde.
c) Abagize Komisiyo bakora imirimo yabo ku bwabo,
kandi manda yabo irangira igihe hatowe
ababasimbura mu nama ikurikira iyo batowemo.
d) Mu gihe cy’amatora, ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano bigomba kureba ko abatorerwa kujya
muri Komisiyo bujuje ibisabwa kandi ko ibice byose
by’isi bihagarariwe ku buryo bungana muri
Komisiyo.
e) Ku bijyanye n'umwanya ubura umuntu, Komisiyo
ubwayo yuzuza uwo mwanya, hitawe ku biteganywa
n'ingingo ibanziriza iyi.
f) Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye aha Komisiyo ibiyorohereza mu
mirimo y’ubuyobozi kugira ngo ibashe kuzuza
inshingano zayo.
2. a) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera, mu gihe cyo kuyashyiraho umukono,
kuyemeza burundu cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe
mu bihugu biyahuriyeho, cyangwa ikindi gihe cyose
nyuma yaho, bishobora gutangaza ko binemeye
uhereye ubwo, bidasabye andi masezerano yihariye
ububasha bwa Komisiyo, mu mibanire yabyo
n’igihugu cyose kiri muri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera na cyo cyemeye iyo nshingano, bwo
kubikoramo amaperereza ku birego byazamurwa
n’ikindi gihugu nk’uko byemewe n’iyi ngingo.
b) Amatangazo avugwa haruguru ashyikirizwa
ushinzwe kubika amasezerano y’Inyongera na we
akoherereza kopi zayo ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera.
c) Komisiyo ifite ububasha bwo:
i) gukora iperereza ku bikorwa byose bikekwaho
kuba ibyaha bikomeye nk’uko bisobanurwa mu
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga no muri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera cyangwa ku kundi kurenga
bikomeye ku Maserano Mpuzamahanga cyangwa
kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera ;
ii) gufasha, binyuze mu gukora ubuhuza, mu
kugarura ibihugu mu nzira yo kubahiriza
Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera.
d) Mu bindi bihe, Komisiyo ikora iperereza bisabwe
n’igihugu kiri mu ntambara, ku bushake bw’ikindi
gihugu cyangwa ibindi bihugu birebwa.
e) Haseguriwe ibiteganywa mu bika bibanziriza iki,
ibikubiye mu ngingo ya 52 y’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya I, ingingo ya 53 y’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya II, ingingo ya 132 y’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga ya III n’ingingo ya 149
y’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ya IV bikomeza
gukurikizwa ku kirego cyose cyo kurenga ku
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga, binakurikizwe ku
kirego cyose cyo kurenga kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera.
3. a) Uretse igihe ibihugu birebwa n’iperereza
bibyumvikanyeho ukundi, iperereza ryose rigomba
gukorwa n’Urugereko rugizwe n’abantu barindwi
batoranywa ku buryo bukurikira :
i) abantu batanu bava mu bagize Komisiyo, bagomba
kuba atari abenegihugu ba kimwe mu bihugu
bihanganye mu ntambara, bashyirwaho na Perezida
wa Komisiyo, yitaye ku ihagararirwa ry’uturere
dutandukanye tw’isi, amaze kungurana ibitekerezo
n’ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara ;
ii) abantu babiri badahoraho, badakomoka muri
kimwe mu bihugu bihanganye mu ntambara,
bashyirwaho n’ibyo bihugu, buri kimwe muri byo
kigashyiraho umwe.
b) Perezida wa Komisiyo akimara kubona ubusabe
bw’iperereza, ashyiraho igihe ntarengwa cyumvikana
cyo gushyiraho Urugereko. Iyo icyo gihe ntarengwa
kirangiye umwe mu bagize Urugereko badahoraho
cyangwa bombi batarashyirwaho, Perezida ahita
ashyiraho ubura cyangwa ababura kugira ngo
umubare w’abagize Urugereko wuzure.
4. a) Urugereko rushyizweho hakurikijwe ibikubiye
mu gika cyacya 3 kugira ngo rukore iperereza rusaba
ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara kurufasha no
gutanga ibimenyetso. Urugereko rushobora na none
gushakisha ibindi bimenyetso rubona ko bikenewe,
ndetse rukanakorera iperereza aho ikibazo cyabereye.
b) Ibimenyetso byose bigomba gutangarizwa ibihugu
birebwa n’iperereza, na byo bigahabwa
uburenganzira bwo kugaragariza Komisiyo icyo
bibivugaho.
c) Buri gihugu gifite uburenganzira bwo kuvuguruza
ibyo bimenyetso.
5. a) Komisiyo igeza ku bihugu birebwa n’iperereza
raporo ku byavuye mu iperereza ryakozwe
n’Urugereko n’ibyifuzonama ibona ko bikwiye.
b) Iyo Urugereko rudashoboye kwegeranya
ibimenyetso bihagije byafasha mu kugaragaza
ibyabaye mu buryo bufitiwe gihamya kandi
butabogamye, Komisiyo igaragaza impamvu
Urugereko rutashoboye kubikora.
c) Komisiyo ntitangaza mu ruhame ibyavuye mu
iperereza ryayo, keretse ibihugu bihanganye mu
ntambara ari byo biyibisabye.
6. Komisiyo ishyiraho amabwiriza ngengamikorere
yayo, harimo n’ibijyanye n’imikorere ya Perezida wa
Komisiyo n’uw’Urugereko. Ayo mabwiriza agomba
guteganya ko imirimo ya Perezida wa Komisiyo
ikorwa ku buryo buhoraho kandi ko, mu gihe
cy’iperereza, ikorwa n’umuntu udakomoka mu
bihugu bihanganye mu ntambara.
7. Amafaranga Komisiyo ikoresha mu mirimo
y’ubuyobozi yishyurwa hakoreshejwe imisanzu
y’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
byakoze itangazo riteganywa mu gika cya 2,
n’imisanzu itangwa ku bushake.
Igihugu cyangwa ibihugu bihanganye mu ntambara
bisabye ko hakorwa iperereza bigomba kubanza
kwishyura amafaranga akenewe mu kwishyura ibyo
Urugereko ruzakoresha mu iperereza, bikazasubizwa
50% byayo n’igihugu cyangwa ibihugu birebwa
n’ibirego. Iyo ibirego bivuguruzanya bishyikirijwe
Urugereko buri gihugu kigomba kubanza gutanga
50% by’amafaranga akenewe.

articles.heading: Uburyozwe Igihugu kiri mu ntambara kirenze ku biteganywa n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga cyangwa aya
articles.text:
Masezerano y’Inyongera, cyirengera kwishyura
