indishyi iyo byemejwe mu rubanza. Kinirengera
ibikorwa byose bikozwe n’abari mu ngabo zacyo.
IGICE CYA VI : INGINGO ZISOZA

articles.heading: Ishyirwa ry’umukono ku Masezerano y’Inyongera Aya Masezerano y’Inyongera yemerewe gushyirwaho umukono n’ibihugu bihuriye ku
articles.text:
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga nyuma y’amezi
atandatu hashyizwe umukono ku Nyandiko isoza
inama kandi akomeza gushyirwaho umukono mu
gihe cy’amezi cumi n’abiri

articles.heading: Kwemezwa burundu Aya Masezerano y’Inyongera agomba kwemezwa burundu vuba bishoboka. Inyandiko ziyemeza
articles.text:
burundu zigomba gushyikirizwa Inama y’Ubumwe
bw’Ubusuwisi, umubitsi w’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga.
Ingingo 94 : Kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
Aya Masezerano y’Inyongera yemerera igihugu icyo
ari cyo cyose kiri mu Masezerano Mpuzamahanga
kitashyize umukono kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera kuba kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho.
Inyandiko zemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
biyahuriyeho zigomba gushyikirizwa Inama
y’Ubumwe bw’Ubusuwisi, umubitsi w’Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga.

articles.heading: Gutangira gukurikizwa 1. Aya Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa nyuma y’amezi atandatu nyuma y’itangwa ry’inyandiko
articles.text:
ebyiri ziyemeza burundu cyangwa zemeza kuba
kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho.
2. Kuri buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera cyayemeje burundu cyangwa cyemeye
kuba kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho nyuma, aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera atangira gukurikizwa
nyuma y’amezi atandatu nyuma y’itangwa
ry’inyandiko yacyo iyemeza burundu cyangwa
yemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho.

articles.heading: Isano ry’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera agitangira gukurikizwa 1. Mu gihe ibihugu bihuriye ku Masezerano
articles.text:
Mpuzamahanga binahuriye kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera, Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga
akurikizwa uko ari yujujwe n’aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera.
2. Iyo kimwe mu bihugu bihanganye mu ntambara
kitari muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera, ibindi
bihugu biyahuriyeho byo bikomeza kuyakurikiza mu
mibanire yabyo. Na none bigomba gukurikiza aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera mu mibanire yabyo na buri
gihugu kitayarimo, niba icyo gihugu na cyo kiyemera
kandi kigakurikiza ibiyakubiyemo.
3. Ubuyobozi buhagarariye abaturage barwanya
igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano mu ntambara
imeze nk’ivugwa mu gika cya 4 cy’ingingo ya mbere,
bushobora kwiyemeza gukurikiza Amasezerano
Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera ku
bijyanye n’iyo ntambara, binyuze mu itangazo
ry’uruhande rumwe bukora bukarishyikiriza
Umubitsi. Nyuma yo kwakirwa n’Umubitsi, iryo
tangazo rigira inkurikizi zikurikira ku bijyanye n’iyo
ntambara :
a) Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera bihita bitangira gukurikizwa kuri ubwo
buyobozi nk’Uruhande ruri mu ntambara ;
b) Ubwo buyobozi bugira uburenganzira bumwe
n’inshingano zimwe nk’iby’igihugu kiri mu
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga no muri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera ;
c) Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga n’aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera bireba ku buryo bungana impande zose
ziri mu ntambara.

articles.heading: Ivugururwa 1. Igihugu cyose kiri muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera gishobora gutanga ibyifuzo by’uko
articles.text:
yavugururwa. Inyandiko y’umushinga w’ivugururwa
ishyikirizwa Umubitsi w’Amasezerano y’Inyongera,
ari na we wemeza, nyuma yo kubyunguranaho
ibitekerezo n’ibihugu byose bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera na Komite Mpuzamahanga
y’Umuryango Utabara Imbabare, niba bikwiye ko
hatumizwa Inama yo kwiga ku mavugururwa
yifujwe.
2. Umubitsi w’Amasezerano atumira muri iyo nama
ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
kimwe n’ibihugu bihuriye ku Masezerano
Mpuzamahanga, byaba byarashyize cyangwa
bitarashyize umukono kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera.

articles.heading: Isubiramo ry’Umugereka wa I 1. Mu gihe kitarenze imyaka ine nyuma y’uko aya Masezerano y’Inyongera atangiye gukurikizwa, na
articles.text:
nyuma yaho mu gihe kitari munsi y’imyaka ine kuri
buri ncuro, Komite Mpuzamahanga y’Umuryango
Utabara Imbabare ivugana n’ibihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano y’Inyongera ku bijyanye
n’Umugereka wa I wayo, kandi iyo isanze ari
ngombwa ishobora gusaba ko hatumizwa inama
y’impuguke igamije gusuzuma Umugereka wa I no
kwerekana ibyaba bikeneye guhindurwamo.Uretse
gusa iyo 1/3 cy’ibyo bihugu kigaragaje ko kibyanze
mu gihe cy’amezi atandatu uhereye igihe ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
byamenyesherejwe icyo cyifuzo, Komite
Mpuzamahanga y’Umuryango Utabara Imbabare
itumiza iyo nama, igatumiramo n’indorerezi
z’imiryango mpuzamahanga bireba. Na none Komite
Mpuzamahanga y’Umuryango Utabara Imbabare
itumiza inama nk’iyo igihe cyose ibisabwe na 1/3
cy’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano.
2. Umubitsi w’Amasezerano y’Inyongera atumiza
inama y’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera n’ibihugu bihuriye ku Masezerano
Mpuzamahanga mu gusuzuma amavugururwa
yasabwe n’inama y’impuguke iyo, nyuma y’iyo
nama, Komite Mpuzamahanga y’Umuryango
Utabara Imbabare ibisabye, cyangwa 1/3 cy’ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano kibisabye.
3. Amavugururwa ku mugereka wa I atorwa n’iyo
nama ku bwiganze bwa bibiri bya gatatu bw’ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
byitabiriye inama kandi bitora.
4. Umubitsi w’Amasezerano y’Inyongera agomba
kumenyesha ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera n’ibihugu bihuriye ku Masezerano
Mpuzamahanga impinduka zose zemejwe.
Ivugururwa rifatwa iryemewe burundu nyuma
y’umwaka umwe rimenyeshejwe ibyo bihugu,
keretse iyo muri icyo gihe cy’umwaka, nibura 1/3
cy’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera byashyikirije Umubitsi itangazo rivuga
ko bitemera iryo vugururwa.
5. Ivugururwa rifashwe nk’iryemewe hakurikijwe
igika cya 4 ritangira gukurikizwa nyuma y’amezi
atatu ryemewe ku bihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera byose, uretse ibyatangaje
ko bitaryemera, mu buryo buhuje n’ibiteganywa muri
icyo gika. Buri gihugu gikoze iryo tangazo gishobora
kurikuraho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, ivugururwa
rigatangira gukurikizwa kuri icyo gihugu hashize
amezi atatu gikuyeho iryo tangazo.
6. Umubitsi amenyesha ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera n’ibihugu biri mu
Masezerano Mpuzamahanga ugutangira gukurikizwa
kw’ivugururwa ryose ryakozwe, ibihugu birebwa
n’iryo vugururwa, itariki ritangiriraho gukurikizwa
kuri buri gihugu, amatangazo yo kutemera iryo
vugururwa yakozwe hakurikijwe igika cya 4,
n’ikurwaho rya bene ayo matangazo.

articles.heading: Ukwivana mu Masezerano y’Inyongera 1. Mu gihe igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera kiyivanyemo, uko kuyivanamo kugira
articles.text:
agaciro nyuma y’umwaka umwe gusa nyuma
y’iyakirwa ry’inyandiko yo kuyivanamo. Icyakora
iyo uwo mwaka urangiye igihugu cyayivanyemo kiri
muri kimwe mu bibazo bivugwa mu ngingo ya
mbere, agaciro ko kwivana mu Masezerano
y’Inyongera kuba kugeza ubwo intambara irangiriye
cyangwa ugufatwa k’ubutaka bw’igihugu, kandi uko
byagenda kose, ntigushobora kugira agaciro mbere
y’isozwa ry’ibikorwa bijyanye no kurekura burundu,
gucyura mu bihugu byabo cyangwa kongera gutuza
abantu barengerwa n’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga
cyangwa n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera.
2. Kwivana mu Masezerano y’Inyongera kugomba
kumenyeshwa mu nyandiko umubitsi
w’Amasezerano y’Inyongera na we akamenyesha
ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera
iryo menyesha.
3. Ukwivana mu Masezerano y’Inyongera kugira
agaciro gusa ku gihugu cyayivanyemo.
4. Nta kwivana mu Masezerano y’Inyongera
gukozwe hakurikijwe igika cya mbere kugira
ingaruka ku nshingano igihugu kiyivanyemo cyagize,
biturutse ku ntambara, hakurikijwe aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera, ku bijyanye n’igikorwa cyose cyakozwe
mbere y’uko uko kwivana mu Masezerano
y’Inyongera gutangira kugira agaciro.

articles.heading: Imenyesha Umubitsi w’Amasezerano y’Inyongera amenyesha ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano kimwe
articles.text:
n’ibihugu bihuriye ku Masezerano Mpuzamahanga,
byaba byarashyize umukono kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera cyangwa bitarawushyizeho:
a) Imikono yashyizwe kuri aya Masezerano y’
Inyongera n’inyandiko zemeza burundu cyangwa
izemeza kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera, zatanzwe hakurikijwe

articles.heading: y’Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga ashyiraho Umuryango w’Abibumbye
articles.text:
2. Umubitsi w’Amasezerano y’Inyongera amenyesha
Ubunyamabanga bw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye
iyemezwa burundu cyangwa ukwemera kuba kimwe
mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera no kuyivanamo yakiriye ku bijyanye
n’aya Masezerano y’Inyongera.
